title: Administration Assistant
description:
Key Responsibilities:

1\. Onboarding Coordination:

o Oversee the entire onboarding process for new employees, from pre\-joining documentation to the first day of work.

o Coordinate with HR to ensure that all necessary work is completed prior to the new hire's start date.

o Prepare and organize new hire kits, which may include Company Brochure, office supplies, laptop/computer setup/Mobile/Sim/Skype id/Email id’s etc.

2\. Induction and Orientation:

o Schedule and facilitate new employee orientation sessions, introducing them to the company culture, policies, and key personnel.

o Provide new hires with a tour of the office, explaining facilities and workspaces.

o Ensure new employees are introduced to relevant departments and teams, and assist them in understanding their role and responsibilities.

3\. System Access and Account Setup:

o Coordinate with IT and other relevant departments to ensure that new employees are set up with necessary system access (email, software, internal tools, etc.).

o Assist new hires with logging into company systems, setting up accounts, and familiarizing them with company platforms.

Communication and Follow\-up:

o Send new joiner email to all staff with details regarding their first day (schedule, designation, reporting person, office location, etc)

o Follow up with new hires during their first week to ensure a smooth transition and address any concerns they may have.

Employee Records Management:

o Maintain up\-to\-date records of all new employee documentation, including signed contracts, and required documents.

o Ensure that all new hire records are compliant with company policies and legal requirements.

Feedback and Improvement:

o Collect feedback from new employees on their onboarding experience and suggest improvements to HR or management.

o Assist in improving onboarding materials and processes to create a more efficient and welcoming experience for future hires.

Appointment Letter Preparation:

o Prepare and draft appointment letters for new employees across all branches.

o Ensure that all required information (e.g., job title, salary, joining date, terms and conditions) is accurately reflected in the appointment letters.

o Tailor appointment letters to meet specific requirements for different branches, if necessary, while adhering to company\-wide standards.

Coordination with HR \& Branch Managers:

o Coordinate with the HR department and branch managers to confirm the details of new hires, ensuring that all necessary information is included in the appointment letter.

o Ensure that the appointment letters align with company policies, job roles, and branch\-specific guidelines.

Issuing Appointment Letters:

o Distribute appointment letters to new employees in a timely manner, both physically and digitally, depending on the branch's location and the employee’s preference.

o Ensure that appointment letters are signed by authorized personnel and returned for documentation and filing.

o Track the issuance of appointment letters to ensure that they are sent out on time and any delays are addressed promptly.

Repair and Maintenance Scheduling:

o Coordinate with internal departments to identify the need for repair work and ensure that vendors are scheduled accordingly.

o Oversee the scheduling of repairs and maintenance, ensuring minimal disruption to the daily operations of the office.

o Ensure that all repair work is completed in a timely manner, following agreed\-upon deadlines.

Monitoring Repair Work:

o Supervise and monitor the progress of repair and maintenance work to ensure that it is completed to the required standard and in a timely fashion.

o Conduct periodic inspections to confirm that repairs meet company quality standards and safety regulations.

o Address any delays or issues with the vendors to avoid further disruptions.

 Inventory Tracking and Control:

o Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of stock inventory, including office supplies, materials, and equipment.

o Monitor stock levels to ensure sufficient quantities are available for day\-to\-day operations.

o Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile discrepancies between physical stock and recorded data.

o Implement stock rotation systems to minimize waste and ensure the proper use of resources.

o Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of stock and resolve any issues related to orders or shipments.

o Ensure the efficient distribution of stock across various departments based on their needs and usage patterns.

o Allocate inventory to internal departments and ensure they receive the materials or products in a timely manner.

o Maintain clear records of stock distribution to track usage by different departments.

Cost Control and Budgeting:

o Track and manage stock\-related expenses, ensuring adherence to the department’s budget.

o Help identify opportunities for cost savings, such as bulk ordering, negotiating better prices, or reducing waste.

o Report any budget discrepancies to senior management and recommend corrective actions.

o Maintain proper documentation for stock transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, delivery receipts, and inventory logs.

o Ensure all inventory records are properly filed and accessible for auditing and future reference.

o Maintain up\-to\-date records for compliance and reporting purposes.

Asset Tracking \& Maintenance:

o Maintain an up\-to\-date register of all company assets (e.g., PCs, laptops, mobile phones, SIM cards, etc.).

o Record and track asset serial numbers, model details, condition, location, and assigned employees.

o Update and monitor the asset management system or spreadsheet regularly.

o Assist in the allocation of new assets to employees and ensure proper documentation.

o Conduct periodic physical audits to verify the accuracy of asset records.

o Manage the disposal of old or unused assets in accordance with company policies.

o Generate and maintain regular reports on asset allocation, usage, and status.

o Keep records of all asset transfers, returns, and repairs.

o Prepare and submit periodic asset status reports to management.

Backup Systems:

o Regularly back up critical documents, files, and data using secure cloud storage or physical storage devices/Hard disk etc.

o Ensure that backup systems are properly functioning and up\-to\-date, conducting routine checks to prevent data loss.

o Implement an organized backup schedule for daily, weekly, and monthly document backups, ensuring comprehensive protection for all critical information.

 Disaster Recovery Planning:

o Develop and implement backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure that office documentation is recoverable in the event of data loss or hardware failure.

o Test and evaluate recovery plans periodically to ensure quick and efficient document restoration during emergencies.

o Collaborate with various departments to ensure all important documents are backed up and stored appropriately.

o Assist team members with retrieving documents and files from the backup system when necessary.

o Notify relevant departments or personnel about important document updates, changes, or backups completed.

Courier Dispatch

o Manage and oversee the dispatch of all outgoing parcels, documents, and packages.

o Receive incoming parcels, packages, or documents, ensuring accurate logging and delivery to the correct department or recipient.

o Monitor courier costs and manage the budget allocated for courier services.

o Seek the most cost\-effective courier services without compromising on the quality or reliability of delivery.

o Assist in negotiating rates and terms with courier companies when necessary.

o Coordinate with internal teams to ensure proper packaging and documentation for all outgoing shipments.

o Liaise with external courier companies to arrange for timely collection and delivery of items.

o Track shipments and maintain communication with courier services to ensure on\-time delivery.

o Follow up with courier services for any delays or issues with deliveries and resolve them efficiently.

o Prepare regular reports on courier activity, including any delays or incidents that may impact the delivery schedule.

o Ensure that delivery and dispatch logs are up\-to\-date and properly filed for future reference.

Support Other Administrative Tasks:

o Assist in cross\-departmental administrative tasks and contribute to the overall operational efficiency of the office.

o Provide backup support to other administrative staff when needed.

title: Camp Coordinator
description:
Job Description: Camp CoordinatorJob Title

**Camp Coordinator**

Department

Marketing / Community Outreach / Business Development/CEO

Reports To

Marketing Manager / Business Development Manager

Job Summary

The Camp Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, and executing medical camps, health awareness programs, and community outreach initiatives. The role involves coordinating with hospitals, corporate organizations, educational institutions, industries, NGOs, and community groups to conduct successful health camps that promote preventive healthcare and generate patient referrals.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, coordinate, and execute health camps, screening programs, and wellness initiatives.
* Identify and develop partnerships with corporates, schools, colleges, industries, residential communities, NGOs, and other organizations for conducting health camps.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, technicians, and administrative teams to ensure smooth camp operations.
* Arrange logistics, including venue setup, medical equipment, promotional materials, transportation, and registration.
* Promote health camps through local marketing activities, digital platforms, and community engagement.
* Ensure all required permissions and approvals are obtained before conducting camps.
* Maintain records of camp attendees, screenings performed, referrals generated, and follow\-up requirements.
* Coordinate post\-camp follow\-up with patients and facilitate appointments for further consultation or treatment.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on camp activities, attendance, and outcomes.
* Manage camp budgets and ensure efficient utilization of resources.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with community leaders, corporate HR teams, educational institutions, and referral partners.
* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, healthcare regulations, and safety protocols during all outreach activities.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Public Health, or a related field.
* Additional certification in healthcare administration or event management is an advantage.

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in healthcare marketing, event coordination, community outreach, or hospital operations.
* Experience in organizing medical camps or public health programs is preferred.

Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and event management abilities.
* Relationship\-building and networking skills.
* Leadership and team coordination.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and reporting tools.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple activities simultaneously.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of health camps organized.
* Camp attendance and participation rates.
* Patient referrals generated from camps.
* Conversion of referrals into hospital consultations or treatments.
* Number of new corporate or community partnerships established.
* Participant satisfaction and feedback.
* Timely submission of reports and documentation.

Working Conditions

* Frequent travel for field visits and camp locations.
* Weekend or holiday work may be required based on camp schedules.
* Coordination with multidisciplinary hospital teams and external organizations.
* Ability to work in outdoor and community\-based environments.

Salary

Salary will be based on qualifications, experience, and organizational policy.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager

**Company:** Aspireon Ventures  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Department:** Human Resources

About Aspireon Ventures

Aspireon Ventures is a growing multi\-vertical organization operating across **education, film \& media, creative services, content, and emerging business ventures**. As we scale our businesses and teams, we are looking for an experienced and hands\-on **HR Manager** who can build strong people systems, culture, and processes from the ground up.

Role Overview

We are looking for an **HR Manager who can build, manage, and scale the entire HR function of a growing organization**.

This is not a conventional HR administration role. The ideal candidate should be capable of taking ownership of HR operations end\-to\-end—from **manpower planning and talent acquisition to payroll, performance management, policies, employee engagement, compliance, and organizational development**.

You will work closely with the management team to build a high\-performance organization with the right people, processes, culture, and systems in place.

Key Responsibilities1\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with Aspireon Ventures' business goals.
* Build HR systems and processes suitable for a growing multi\-vertical organization.
* Develop organizational structures, reporting frameworks, job roles, and HR workflows.
* Work closely with management on manpower planning and workforce requirements.
* Support the organization in building a strong and performance\-driven culture.

2\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from identifying manpower requirements to onboarding.
* Develop effective recruitment strategies for creative, academic, corporate, sales, media, and operational roles.
* Create and optimize Job Descriptions and hiring processes.
* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, recruitment platforms, referrals, and other channels.
* Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews with department heads and management.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future requirements.
* Reduce hiring turnaround time while maintaining quality of recruitment.

3\. Payroll \& Compensation

* Manage monthly payroll processes and ensure accurate and timely salary processing.
* Maintain employee salary structures, incentives, deductions, attendance, leave, and payroll records.
* Coordinate with accounts/finance teams for payroll\-related activities.
* Assist management in developing compensation structures and employee benefits.

4\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and maintain company HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure proper documentation of employment\-related processes.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Establish proper processes for attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, resignation, and full \& final settlement.

5\. Performance Management

* Design and implement employee performance evaluation systems.
* Establish KRAs/KPIs in coordination with department heads.
* Manage probation, confirmation, performance reviews, promotions, and increments.
* Identify performance gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Help build a culture of accountability and measurable performance.

6\. Employee Engagement \& Culture

* Build a positive, professional, and collaborative workplace culture.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives and internal communication systems.
* Address employee concerns and grievances professionally.
* Improve employee retention and overall employee experience.
* Act as a trusted bridge between management and employees.

7\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training and development requirements across departments.
* Coordinate internal and external training programs.
* Develop employee development plans based on organizational requirements.
* Support leadership in building future\-ready teams.

8\. HR Operations \& Administration

* Manage onboarding and employee induction processes.
* Maintain accurate employee databases and HR documentation.
* Monitor attendance, leave, working hours, and employee records.
* Manage employee lifecycle processes from joining to exit.
* Prepare regular HR reports and workforce analytics for management.

What We Are Looking For

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **3–6 years of relevant experience in HR**, preferably in a growing company, startup, education, media, creative, or multi\-business environment.
* Strong experience in **end\-to\-end HR management**.
* Proven ability to independently build HR systems and processes.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, payroll, performance management, employee relations, and HR policies.
* Good understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work closely with founders/management and department heads.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in HRMS, MS Office/Google Workspace, and recruitment platforms.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following environments will be preferred:

* Startups or fast\-growing organizations
* Education / EdTech
* Media \& Entertainment
* Creative agencies
* Digital marketing / content companies
* Multi\-location organizations
* Organizations undergoing rapid team expansion

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks beyond traditional HR.**
* Can build HR systems from scratch.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving organization.
* Can independently handle both strategic HR and day\-to\-day HR operations.
* Understands how to hire and retain creative, academic, technical, and corporate talent.
* Has strong ownership and accountability.
* Can balance employee needs with organizational objectives.
* Is proactive, approachable, and solution\-oriented.
* Is capable of building an HR department that can scale with the organization.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

The HR Manager will be evaluated on:

* Quality and speed of recruitment
* Employee retention
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Payroll accuracy and timeliness
* HR process implementation
* Employee engagement
* Performance management effectiveness
* Compliance and documentation
* Employee satisfaction
* Training and development initiatives
* Overall HR system maturity and scalability

Why Join Aspireon Ventures?

* Opportunity to **build and lead the HR function of a growing organization**.
* Work across multiple business verticals including education, media, creative, and emerging ventures.
* Direct interaction with management and leadership.
* Opportunity to create systems and processes rather than simply follow existing ones.
* Growth\-oriented and dynamic work environment.
* Opportunity to shape organizational culture and build high\-performing teams.

**If you are an HR professional who enjoys building organizations, developing people, and creating systems from the ground up, we would love to hear from you.**

**Apply now and be part of Aspireon Ventures' growth journey.**

==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

company: kinemach engineering and machines pvt ltd
description:
About Kinemach

Kinemach is a manufacturing technology and solutions company based in Pune, designing and building assembly automation lines, material handling and robotics systems, processing equipment, packaging machinery, and inspection/testing systems for customers across automotive, pharmaceutical, food processing, electronics, and rubber/plastics industries. Our product portfolio includes two specialised brands: Procer Mixing, which manufactures high\-shear mixers, homogenizers, and turnkey process plants for the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries, built to GMP and precision rotor\-stator tolerances; and DynaScrew, which manufactures precision automatic screw\-feeding and driving systems used in automotive, electronics, aerospace, and medical\-device assembly.

Because our machines are custom\-engineered, precision\-built, and shipped to customers who expect documented, repeatable quality, QA/QC is central to how we deliver \- from the raw material and bought\-out components that come in, through machining and assembly, to the functional testing and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) before a machine leaves our facility.

Role Summary

We are looking for a QA/QC Engineer to own quality checks across all three product lines \- Kinemach's automation and assembly systems, Procer's mixing and homogenizing equipment, and DynaScrew's screw\-feeding and driving systems. This is a hands\-on, shop\-floor role: you will inspect incoming materials and components, verify in\-process machining and assembly against engineering drawings, run functional and calibration checks on finished sub\-assemblies and machines, and maintain the inspection records and documentation our customers and quality systems require.

Key Responsibilities

\- Perform incoming quality inspection of raw materials, castings, and bought\-out components (motors, sensors, PLCs, pneumatics, fasteners) against purchase specifications and drawings.

\- Carry out in\-process dimensional inspection during machining and fabrication using standard measuring instruments (verniers, micrometers, dial/height gauges); read and verify parts against engineering drawings and GD\&T callouts.

\- Conduct functional and calibration testing on assembled sub\-systems \- for example torque verification and screw\-feed accuracy on DynaScrew stations, and rotor\-stator clearance, leak, and CIP/SIP checks on Procer mixing equipment.

\- Support final inspection and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of completed machines prior to dispatch, including preparing FAT checklists and test records for customer sign\-off.

\- Raise, document, and track Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs); coordinate with production, design, and vendors on root cause and corrective actions.

\- Maintain calibration schedules and records for measuring and test instruments, and ensure traceability of inspection data.

\- Prepare and maintain quality documentation \- inspection reports, quality plans, test certificates \- in line with ISO 9001 requirements, and GMP\-related documentation for Procer's pharma/food equipment where applicable.

\- Assist with vendor/supplier quality evaluation and periodic audits of incoming material quality.

\- Flag recurring quality issues on the shop floor and support continuous improvement in inspection methods and process controls.

Requirements

\- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, or Mechatronics Engineering (or equivalent).

\- 0\-3 years of experience in a QA/QC, quality inspection, or manufacturing quality role \- freshers with strong fundamentals and internship/project exposure to inspection are welcome to apply.

\- Working knowledge of standard measuring instruments (vernier caliper, micrometer, dial/height gauge); exposure to CMM is a plus.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, including basic GD\&T.

\- Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management concepts and basic documentation practices (inspection reports, NCRs, calibration records).

\- Comfortable working on the shop floor across machining, assembly, and testing areas, not only at a desk.

\- Good communication skills to coordinate with production, design, and vendors; proficiency with MS Office (Excel in particular).

Preferred (Good to Have)

\- Prior exposure to capital equipment, custom machine building, or low\-volume/high\-mix manufacturing rather than mass\-production QA.

\- Familiarity with GMP requirements or quality expectations for pharmaceutical/food processing equipment.

\- Basic exposure to electromechanical or mechatronic system testing (torque tools, sensors, PLC\-driven equipment).

What We Offer

\- Direct, hands\-on exposure to three distinct engineering product lines \- automation, precision mixing/process equipment, and precision fastening systems \- under one roof.

\- Close mentorship from senior engineering and quality teams on custom machine\-building practices not typically seen in mass\-production QA roles.

\- A shop\-floor\-first culture where quality engineers work directly alongside design, machining, and assembly teams.

Location: Pune, Maharashtra (On\-site)

Experience: 0\-3 years

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

The role ensures users receive appropriate access to perform their job responsibilities while maintaining compliance with company security policies, regulatory requirements, and access governance standards.


The IAM Analyst will work closely with business users, application owners, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, and IAM leadership to support identity lifecycle management and access governance processes in a timely and secure manner.

* Support role assignments and entitlement management across enterprise applications.
* Assist with privileged account administration activities.

**Identity Lifecycle Support**

* Maintain user accounts in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and other IAM platforms.
* Monitor onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure timely access changes.
* Coordinate with HR, managers, and application owners regarding access requirements.

title: Timekeeping
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and record all drivers’ punch IN and OUT from biometric / timekeeping systems on a daily basis.
* Verify that each driver is punching as per assigned shift (start time, end time, break time) and highlight deviations.
* Prepare, update, and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly attendance sheets for all drivers (present, absent, late, early out, overtime).
* Call and follow up with drivers before shift start to ensure they report on time and are ready with their assigned vehicle and route.
* Track all drivers during the day as per route plan or trip sheet, coordinating with Dispatch/Operations for any changes in schedule.
* Inform the Logistics/Transport Manager immediately in case of no‑show, late arrival, or early punch out of any driver.
* Maintain and update driver roster/shift schedule (weekly/monthly) in coordination with the Transport/Operations team.
* Coordinate with HR/Payroll to share final attendance, overtime hours, and discrepancy reports for salary processing within the defined timeline.
* Investigate and correct attendance issues such as missed punches, duplicate punches, or system errors after approval from the supervisor.
* Maintain proper records and files (soft copy and hard copy) of attendance, shift rosters, and driver contact details for audit and reference.
* Support management with daily/weekly MIS reports on driver availability, utilization, overtime, and absenteeism.
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of all timekeeping data and follow company policies related to attendance and discipline.

Pay: ₹29,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

title: Operations Manager
description:
An **Operations Manager** in a construction company is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the company’s day\-to\-day construction operations across multiple projects. The role focuses on ensuring projects have the required manpower, materials, machinery, subcontractors, finances, and management support to achieve **time, cost, quality, safety, and productivity targets**.

Key Responsibilities

* **Project Operations \& Execution** – Oversee ongoing construction projects, review work progress, identify delays or operational problems, and coordinate corrective actions with Project Managers and Site Engineers.
* **Planning \& Scheduling** – Review project schedules, monthly/weekly targets, resource requirements, and construction priorities to ensure timely completion.
* **Manpower Management** – Coordinate deployment of engineers, supervisors, operators, skilled workers, and labour across different project sites based on workload and priorities.
* **Material \& Procurement Coordination** – Monitor requirements for cement, steel, aggregates, bitumen, construction chemicals, and other materials; coordinate with procurement and suppliers for timely delivery.
* **Machinery \& Equipment Management** – Plan allocation and utilization of excavators, JCBs, rollers, dumpers, batching plants, vehicles, and other equipment while monitoring breakdowns, maintenance, fuel consumption, and productivity.
* **Cost \& Budget Control** – Monitor project expenditure against budgets, identify cost overruns, control wastage, and coordinate with accounts and project teams to improve project profitability. Cost and operational\-risk oversight are common elements of the role.
* **Subcontractor \& Vendor Management** – Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, transporters, equipment owners, and service providers; monitor their performance and resolve operational issues.
* **Quality \& Safety Monitoring** – Ensure construction activities follow approved drawings, specifications, quality requirements, safety procedures, and applicable contractual/regulatory requirements.
* **Progress Monitoring \& Reporting** – Review daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, physical versus financial progress, resource utilization, pending activities, and project performance.
* **Coordination Between Office \& Sites** – Act as a key communication link between company management, Project Managers, Site Engineers, Accounts, Purchase, HR, and other departments.
* **Client \& Department Coordination** – Coordinate with clients, consultants, engineers, government departments, and other stakeholders regarding progress, approvals, inspections, and operational requirements.
* **Billing \& Cash\-Flow Coordination** – Follow up on measurements, running account bills, subcontractor bills, client payments, and project cash requirements in coordination with the billing and accounts teams.
* **Problem Solving** – Address shortages of manpower/materials, equipment breakdowns, site constraints, subcontractor issues, approval delays, and other problems affecting project execution.
* **Performance Management** – Establish operational targets and monitor site productivity, equipment utilization, material consumption, project costs, and team performance.
* **Management Reporting** – Provide senior management with regular reports on project status, financial performance, major risks, resource requirements, delays, and decisions requiring management approval.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

lead design engineer \- Turbine
  
  

**Working location:** HIP/ Prithla, India
  
  

General Description
  
  

LEAD DESIGN ENGINEER \- TURBINE in TURBINE ENGINEERING, with designations ranging from Sr. Manager to DGM (in commensurate with experience) for Executing Basic and Detail Design of Large Hydro conventional \& Large / small Refurbishment projects and spares for OEM (Own) as well as Non\-OEM.

Reverse engineering, Problem analysis in the existing plant
  
Concept \& Detail design of Turbine assemblies and components.
  
Layouts, Drawings, BoMs, Purchase specifications
  
Continuous improvement of product \& processes, optimisation
  
Technical troubleshooting / NCR handling (study the issue and providing solution) at shop and site
  
Handling customer queries and approvals for Indian and International projects
  
Design collaboration and reviews with technical experts in parent company at Europe
  
Team (4 to 5 Engineers) handling / planning activity.
  
Response to customer and internal departments.
  
  

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
  
  

**Education:** B.E/ M.E./M. Tech \- Mechanical Engineering from reputed Institute

10\+ years of experience in mechanical design of Hydro Turbines using 3D CAD software (NX and Team Center preferable)
  
Sound knowledge of mechanical engineering design concepts
  
Understanding of materials and manufacturing processes involved
  
Experience of technical trouble shooting
  
Proactive, avid learner, team player, good communication ability
  
**Languages:** Proficiency in English, Hindi
  
Product Know\-How
  
Hydro Turbine Design \& Engineering along with the whole product life cycle
  
Readiness to travel.

Solid Mechanical \& Hydraulic engineering fundamentals
  
Astute designer’s aptitude \& approach

description:
**Overview**
------------


You will be working closely with regional win work/technical leads and business development \& the engagement team across AtkinsRéalis and the wider organisation to produce compelling bids. As a member of the central Bid Management team, you will also be responsible for contributing to the continuous improvement of the win\-work capability (people, processes, tools, information, and governance). You will report to the Proposal Managers (Canada) and Win Work Team lead (GTC)

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the development and application of proposal/bid themes. Develop organization chart with the pursuit team.
* Coordinate communication between SMEs and proposal writers. Lead teams through strategic reviews as per internal schedule.
* Exercise considerable initiative and independent judgment about content, wording, completeness, correctness, and appropriateness of proposal contents and graphics materials, making recommendations directly to pursuit team.
* Supervise marketing assistants and/or less experienced proposal coordinators. Give work directions to graphic artists and marketing assistants involved in proposal production.
* Experience managing teams to deliver by established deadlines.
* Ensuring that the proposal is run in accordance with best practice and the win work capture plan and pursuit process, and in compliance with the Service Delivery Process.
* Provide client service, commitment, communication, innovation \& continuous improvement, professionalism, quality and teamwork. (Note that "Clients" may be internal managers and staff.)
* Added advantage if you have experience in capture planning
* Implement and facilitate capture planning process
* Facilitate kick off workshops and Go/No Go call
* Facilitate win theme sessions and supporting strategies
* Initiate and drive Go No Go calls and risk cat tool
* Portal Management (CRM tools) and Review procurement documents and attachments.
* Create and maintain a Proposal Management Plan.
* Develop compliance matrix, Storyboard templates and allocate bid deliverables.
* Review / approve response for standard prequalification questions.
* Check PQQ responses from JV partners (if applicable).
* Graphics co\-ordination, (colour schemes; word templates; document covers and dividers; images / photos; graphics / charts / graphs (where applicable) and Graphics approval in accordance with company's Branding Guidelines.
* Work involves knowledgeable application of quality control as well as standard procedures and criteria to the coordination of proposals which are of critical importance to the firm.
* Assist in the development of preparation for Stage\-gate reviews – and facilitate bid go/no\-go decision.
* Support development of CVs.
* Work with the Business Development team to schedule \& co\-ordinate communications activities necessary to identify customer issues, hot buttons and the associated win themes and win strategy statements. Occasionally contact upper management for required signatures.
* Support the production of case studies / evidence scenarios.
* Coordinate with support services (legal, accounting, HR) on administrative sections of the pursuits (e.g., forms, statistics).
* Take constructive feedback and apply it to enhance the delivery.

*Submission*

* Final quality review of documents, post\-formatting and after Bid Coordinator proofread /sense check.
* Final proofread / compliance check of tender documents.
* Close\-out actions with JV partners (if required).
* Client Presentation, Negotiate \& Contract, Feedback, Handover
* Lead, review, approve and disseminate Lessons Learnt feedback – Proposal Lead to lead the session with support from the Bid Co\-ordinator.
* Support response to Client Queries.
* Support preparation for client interviews / presentations.

**About you**
-------------

* Have 5\-10 years (A/E/C industry)
* Have experience leading pursuit responses – the larger and complex ones.
* Understanding of Architectural\-Engineering and project and construction management industry standards and disciplines. Can translate abstract ideas or narrative text into graphical concepts to illustrate concepts more effectively.
* Works independently yet functions effectively as a member of a team.
* Promote and demonstrate team values and behaviours in line with the win work team practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Relationship building
* Ability to multi\-task and manage several projects at once
* Attention to detail
* Collaborative approach
* Time management skills
* Enthusiastic, initiative and the confidence to start things from scratch
* Confident using digital tools and learning new ones
* Promote the use of AtkinsRéalis work winning processes and tools
* Instill a culture where others share knowledge, insights and learning

*Specific skills required*

* A strong communicator with strong grammar, spelling, composition, and proofreading abilities.
* Able to evaluate, monitor and present ideas and data.
* Analytical with solid organisational skills, scheduling and prioritising activities.
* A flexible but methodical approach to supporting bids.
* Computer skills required and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Adobe Creative Suite, CRM, and other software programmes including LLMs.
* Comfortable and effective when working across all levels of an organisation.
* Makes sound decisions, but also works with other stakeholders (e.g., sales lead, capture lead, PM) to gain buy\-in.

**Rewards \& benefits**
-----------------------


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.


This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------


We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

description:
**Job Responsibilities** Provide inputs and takes ownership to manage the HR functions (HR Operations, Compensation, Learning and Development, Talent Management, Employer Branding); conceptualizing and implementing programs.

**HR Team and Processes Management**

* Keeps a tab on the feedback of the people by leveraging various sources (HealthCheck, pulse surveys, skips, etc) and drives effective programs that continue to improve engagement and the people experience
* Advises key stakeholders on methods to reinforce and strengthen culture, community and engagement
* Partners with business leaders on issue identification, action planning, and office engagement initiatives
* Participates in and supports recognition programs and communications
* Oversees employee relation issues which may include: performance and discipline, investigations, conflict resolution session(s), and actioning closures.
* Create and Analyze HR metrics time and again to make effective decision
* Drive analytics to provide insights to leadership on the internal/external trends and movements in compensation
* Assist in the performance reviews and annual compensation revision process
* Apply attrition control measures

* Drive effective employee engagement initiatives regularly and build powerful connect with the employees
* Liaises across HR teams to support stakeholders with specific issue area (onboarding, orientation, people guidelines, POSH etc)
* Develops and communicates people guidelines, policies and procedures
* Works with other HR team and other corporate function to create and maintain best practices that drive shared outcomes and deliver strong impact/ positive customer experience
* Provides mentorship, coaching and guidance to broader HR team
* Serves as a change management agent/champion

**Performance \& Coaching and Mentoring**

* Provides expertise and partners with the business leaders and performance management team to validate performance information, promotion recommendations and coaching activities
* Supports leadership sessions and communications about performance and promotions
* May lead performance management follow ups for Managers and junior team members
* Is a champion to create a culture of ongoing feedback and high performance
* Works closely with the Business partners to identify training needs and areas for improvement
* Providing direction for setting of KRAs/ Goal Setting to employees and execution of Performance Management system
* Assess training needs to apply and monitor training program

**Good to have Skills**

* Team player, highly responsive and customer focus orientated and strong organizational and planning skills
* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Solid understanding of HR compliance
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Ability to maintain high level of confidentiality and work with highly sensitive data and information
* Experience working in a fast\-paced and changing environment
* Strong mental agility and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to establish key relationships with business leaders and develop strong credibility

**Qualification and Experience Required**

Masters degree, or equivalent, in a related field (HR, MBA) is preferred. 10\-15 years of experience is preferred, with 10 or 10 plus years in HRBP activities ( Employee Engagement, Employee Relations, Performance Management and HR strategy). Immediate Joiners will be preferred (Night Shift).

Pay: ₹2,000,000\.00 \- ₹2,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Analysis & Underwriting - Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Summary:**  

Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.  

In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.  

Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.

 **Major Duties:**  

* Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
* Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
* Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
* Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
* Contributes to division\-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
* Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
* Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process\-related guidelines, and controls.
* Consistently adheres to established QUALITY \& QUANTITY SLAs.
* Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
* Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
* Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.

  

**Qualifications:**  

* Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
* Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.
**Experience \& Skills:**  

* 2 \- 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution\-based’ approach
* Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
* Self\-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
* Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
* Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.
 **Shift Coverage:** EMEA \- 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST

 **About the Team**  

This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long\-term organizational resilience.  

The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Senior Manager – Labour Compliance & Governance
description:
India's labour law landscape is undergoing its most significant transformation in decades. The consolidation of over 40 central statutes into four Labour Codes is reshaping how enterprises manage workforce compliance — and GE Vernova needs a senior leader who can build the frameworks to get it right.
  

As the Labour Compliance Leader, you will own enterprise\-wide implementation of the four Labour Codes across a complex, multi\-site organization spanning corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites across India. You will design the governance infrastructure, lead the audits, shape the policies, and be the authoritative voice that helps business and HR leaders navigate India's evolving statutory landscape with confidence.
  

This is a high\-impact senior role for someone who brings deep expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
**Job Description**
===================


**What You'll Do**


* **Lead enterprise Labour Code implementation** — own compliance readiness across all business units, establish governance controls and monitoring frameworks, drive closure of implementation gaps through structured action plans, and advance the digitization of labour compliance processes.
* **Own the compliance calendar and audit function** — develop and manage the statutory filings, returns, renewals, and amendment schedule; lead labour audits; coordinate with labour inspectors, auditors, and government authorities; and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
* **Govern contractor and vendor compliance** — oversee the statutory compliance of manpower contractors and vendors across factories and project sites, conduct periodic audits, and enforce corrective actions where required.
* **Support labour and employee relations** — liaise with Office Labour Governance, People Operations, Project Site Managers, and Factory Labour Relations teams; support resolution of labour disputes and inspections; and represent the organization in labour hearings, conciliation proceedings, and government inspections.
* **Design and standardize compliance policy** — develop labour compliance Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and frameworks; standardize processes across all operating environments; and serve as a subject matter expert for leadership decision\-making on compliance matters.
* **Enable capability across the organization** — conduct regular training for HR professionals, site leaders, factory managers, and contractors on applicable labour laws, new Labour Codes, and compliance obligations.

**Who You Are**


You are a seasoned labour law and compliance professional with deep knowledge of India's Central and State statutory frameworks, and hands\-on experience operating across multi\-site, complex industrial environments.


**Required**


* A formal education and subsequent Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law (LLB), Human Resources (HR), Industrial Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in labour law compliance, industrial relations, and statutory compliance within manufacturing, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or project\-based organizations.
* Proven track record implementing and managing compliance under Central and State Labour Laws, including the new Labour Codes.
* Hands\-on experience managing compliance across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and project sites.
* Demonstrated experience handling labour inspections, statutory audits, government authorities, and legal proceedings.
* Solid experience in contractor and vendor compliance management.
* Strong working knowledge of the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety Health and Working Conditions (OSHWC) Code, and Wage Code.
* Familiarity with compliance management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), and standard productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office).

**Preferred**


* Master's degree in HR, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare (MLW), Personnel Management, or an MBA in HR.
* Professional certifications in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Compliance Management, or Occupational Health and Safety.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Analyst, HR Support Operations
description:
**Job Description :**


**Senior Analyst, HR Support Operations**


**About News Corp:**


News Corp is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content to consumers throughout the world. The Company comprises leading businesses across a range of media, including news and information services, subscription video services in Australia, book publishing, and digital real estate services. Distributed under some of the world’s most recognizable brands—including The Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones, The Australian, HarperCollins Publishers, and realtor.com—our commitment to premium content makes our properties a premier destination for news, information, and entertainment across traditional and digital platforms.


**What You’ll Do:**


As a Senior Analyst, you will serve as the central coordinator for the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, managing the operational logistics of onboarding, offboarding, and global mobility for diverse business units. Navigating a complex tech stack, including Workday and ServiceNow, you will maintain data integrity, resolve policy inquiries, and ensure the accurate execution of system transactions. Acting as a primary point of contact for employees and vendors, you will balance high\-volume task management with strict documentation and reporting standards to ensure audit compliance and meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Provide cross\-business unit, global coverage for six business units across six countries.
* **Employee Lifecycle Orchestration:** Act as the single point of contact to coordinate and manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle events—from onboarding to offboarding—with a dedicated focus on a positive employee experience.
* **HR Tech \& Vendor Integration:** Navigate and manage workflows within a diverse global tech stack (including Workday and ServiceNow) while collaborating with specialist vendors such as Tax Advisory, Background Checking, local Benefits, Immigration and others.
* **Policy Guidance \& Support:** Resolve HR\-related queries and provide expert guidance to workers on company policies, system transactions, and the promotion of self\-service tools to improve efficiency.
* **Global Mobility Administration:** Provide oversight and end\-to\-end administration of global mobility cases, ensuring seamless cross\-business unit and vendor collaboration.
* **Data Integrity \& Compliance:** Follow established processes to ensure data accuracy and perform regular audits to meet strict internal, external, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* **Audit Execution:** Facilitate internal and external audit cycles by providing requested reports, conducting sample testing, and delivering evidence to validate process compliance.
* **SLA \& Performance Excellence:** Manage individual workload to deliver high\-quality results in line with predetermined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* **System \& Process Optimization:** Partner with the HR Systems and Solutions Team to identify issues and recommend enhancements that improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the overall HR function.
* **Documentation \& Workflow:** Maintain clear documentation for system workflows and lifecycle events to ensure consistency and audit readiness across the organization.
* **Project Leadership:** Lead and execute ad\-hoc HR operations projects, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive strategic outcomes.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for HR operations, continuously building deep domain knowledge to provide authoritative guidance and maintain operational excellence.

**Qualifications:**


**Critical Thinking \& Analysis**


* **Systems Impact Awareness:** Proven capacity to foresee and assess how HRIS changes and updates affect interconnected platforms.
* **Operational Foresight:** Robust capability to evaluate the wider effects of operational processes, protecting the consistency and robustness of data down the line.
* **Integrated Problem Solving:** Skilled at investigating the comprehensive effects of system practices, proactively addressing and neutralizing potential integration errors.
* **Analytical Precision:** Strong talent for grasping intricate system configurations and the secondary effects of HR management on company procedures.

**Education \& Experience**


* Possesses a Master’s degree or equivalent professional background in a relevant field.
* 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in HR Operations.

**Technical Proficiency**


* Extensive experience utilizing modern HRIS solutions, specifically Workday and ServiceNow.
* Proficiency in managing complex system workflows and maintaining data integrity across integrated platforms.

**Soft Skills \& Operational Agility**


* Exceptional written and verbal interpersonal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Proven client support capabilities, including active listening and the ability to interpret and fulfill client requirements.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks effectively and escalate complex matters for validation when appropriate.
* Operational agility to support global business processes across multiple time zones (UK, AUS, and US).

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic.


**Reasonable Accommodation**


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com . Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

description:
**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? For the better. Together.

  


Are you passionate about connecting great people with meaningful global opportunities? At Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, we are strengthening the way we attract, select, and engage talent across countries, cultures, and markets. As part of our Global Talent Acquisition team, you will play an important role in building international talent pipelines, supporting specialist and leadership hiring, and creating a professional, consistent, and engaging candidate experience across the Hellmann world.

=================

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes for global specialist and leadership positions across multiple functions, regions and international markets

* Conduct structured interviews and support hiring decisions based on role\-related criteria, professional expertise, leadership potential, motivation and cultural fit
* Act as a trusted recruiting advisor to stakeholders by challenging requirements, advising on market realities, and ensuring a fair, consistent, and evidence\-based hiring process

* Proven recruitment experience in an international environment, ideally including specialist, professional, and leadership hiring across countries or regions
* Strong active sourcing skills and the ability to identify, approach, and engage passive candidates in different markets
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and hiring managers, with the confidence to advise, challenge, and influence constructively
* Strong knowledge of modern recruiting technologies, applicant tracking systems, and data\-driven recruiting practices
* Excellent communication skills in English; German and/or another additional language is an advantage but not a requirement
* A structured, proactive, and solution\-oriented working style combined with strong service orientation
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling confidential information

* A strong Team Spirit and a lot of fun together
* A safe, multi\-cultural and inclusive environment
* Individual opportunities for growth and development

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------


FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Manage the delivery and governance of FedEx’s global total rewards, wellness, and mobility administration services from the GCS, ensuring accurate, compliant, and employee\-centered execution across compensation, benefits, wellness, and mobility programs. Drive operational excellence, service quality, and vendor coordination to support enterprise workforce priorities and seamless employee experiences.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and oversee the operational delivery of total rewards, wellness, and mobility programs across global employee populations, ensuring consistent, high\-quality service execution.
* Lead and direct GCS\-based administration and operational support for compensation programs, wellness initiatives, employee benefits coordination, and mobility services.
* Ensure accurate and compliant execution of global compensation activities, including merit review planning, incentive administration, compensation communications, and budget coordination.
* Manage global mobility operations, including assignment management, relocation coordination, immigration support, and policy compliance activities.
* Monitor the overall effectiveness and operational performance of total rewards, wellness, and mobility programs through service metrics, employee feedback, and operational KPIs.
* Partner with HR COEs, HR Business Partners, vendors, and business leaders to ensure tight alignment between operational delivery and enterprise workforce priorities.
* Oversee vendor governance, coordination, and performance management activities across wellness providers, mobility vendors, and rewards administration partners.
* Serve as the senior GCS escalation point for operational issues related to compensation administration, wellness program support, and employee mobility services.

**Knowledge \& Experience**

* Extensive experience in total rewards operations, mobility administration, wellness program delivery, or HR shared services environments within large global organizations.
* Strong operational understanding of compensation administration, employee benefits operations, mobility services, and workforce support processes.
* Experience managing operational governance, service delivery standards, compliance, and audit activities across HR operations functions.
* Proven ability to manage and coordinate complex employee programs and vendor ecosystems across geographically distributed workforce populations.
* Experience leveraging operational metrics, workforce insights, and service delivery analytics to improve program effectiveness and employee experience.

**Key Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Service Management
* Vendor Management
* Experience Design

  

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------


FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Executive to support the organization's human resource functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and HR administration. The ideal candidate will help create a positive work environment while ensuring HR processes are efficient and compliant with company policies and applicable labor laws.

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination, and onboarding.
