title: Senior Product Manager, Data & AI — Corporate Functions (HR & Legal)
description:
### **Senior Product Manager, Data \& AI — Corporate Functions (HR \& Legal)**


* JR\-162596
* Hybrid
* Bengaluru
* Technology Enablement
* Full time

**Who are we?**



Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

  


A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.



A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**About the Role**



We're building HR and Legal data products that power workforce planning, talent strategy, compliance, and risk management across the enterprise. These products unify data from core systems such as Workday, Agiloft, SFDC, ServiceNow, and are delivered through a unified enterprise analytics and intelligence platform: a trusted single source of reference that exposes insight through APIs, semantic models, dashboards, and conversational and agentic AI experiences.



As Product Manager, you'll help drive the data and analytics product strategy and roadmap for our Corporate Functions (HR and Legal). You'll partner closely with stakeholders to understand their strategic priorities, operating rhythms, and pain points — fragmented data, manual reporting, limited scenario planning, and governance gaps — and translate them into high\-impact, AI\-enabled data products that sharpen insight, automate reporting, and elevate HR and Legal as strategic advisors to the business.



This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, business strategy, and applied AI. You'll turn complex business needs into a clear product roadmap while working hand\-in\-hand with data engineers to ship scalable, reliable, and high\-impact solutions.



This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role for someone who can operate at both strategic and technical depth, partner effectively with engineering and business stakeholders, and who has hands\-on experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products.



**What You'll Do**


* **Partner \& advise:** Build trusted relationships with HR and Legal stakeholders, understanding their objectives, operating cadence, and core processes. Translate pain points (attrition risk, skills and talent strategy, DEI reporting, contract bottlenecks, compliance governance) into data product solutions and manage expectations within and across functions.

* **Shape strategy \& roadmap:** Drive the product strategy and an ROI\-informed roadmap, balancing quick\-win delivery against foundational platform work, technical debt, and scalability.

* **Build data products:** Own function\-grade semantic models that integrate with the enterprise platform, model store, and query APIs. Productize analytics and AI/ML services while upholding platform principles: system of reference, domain data ownership, and full lineage, provenance, and auditability.

* **Deliver end\-to\-end:** Lead delivery from problem framing and data feasibility through model evaluation, deployment, and adoption. Build prototypes, define test cases and UAT, run agile release cycles, and ensure data quality, security, and compliance on everything shipped.

* **Analyze the market:** Track industry practices and emerging HR and Legal analytics and AI trends (predictive attrition, skills intelligence, contract analytics, compliance automation), and bring in best\-in\-class governance frameworks (GDPR, data privacy, records compliance).

* **Build business cases \& measure success:** Develop financial models and opportunity reviews, and define the metrics that prove product value (adoption, reporting cycle\-time reduction, forecast accuracy, model quality, automation ROI).

* **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** Work hand\-in\-hand with data platform, data science, AI/ML, and engineering teams on pipeline design, backlog refinement, and product training.
  


**What You'll Bring**


* 8\+ years of product management experience (3\+ years as a Data Analyst/similar role supporting cross\-functional global business units, for candidates coming from an analytics background), with at least 2–3 years focused on data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML products.

* Bachelor's degree preferred in Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.

* Strong technical fluency: enterprise data platforms, semantic and data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and the AI/ML lifecycle (data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring). Comfortable with SQL and hands\-on data analysis.


* Demonstrated experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products (predictive models, LLM\-based applications, automation tools).

* Solid grasp of data governance: lineage, provenance, auditability, and domain data ownership.

* Knowledge of HR and/or Legal concepts (workforce planning, people analytics, compliance, data privacy, contract lifecycle management) is a strong plus.

* Excellent communicator who can simplify the complex, flex between technical depth and business storytelling, and build trust across HR, Legal, IT, Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams.

* Bias for action and ownership: breaks down complex problems, drives alignment, and stays decisive.
  



Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing form.


Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

description:
**Job Title: Marketing Executive – Candidate Marketing**

As a **Marketing Executive**, you will be responsible for strategically marketing candidates' profiles across the open job market and maximizing their interview opportunities. You will work closely with candidates to optimize their professional presence, apply for relevant job opportunities, and coordinate throughout the placement process until they secure employment.

This role focuses on **candidate marketing, job applications, profile optimization, and placement support** to help candidates achieve successful career outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, optimize, and maintain candidates' LinkedIn profiles to meet industry standards.
* Market candidates' profiles across multiple job portals and professional networking platforms.
* Apply for suitable job opportunities on behalf of candidates based on their skills and experience.
* Search and identify relevant job openings across the USA, Canada, UK, and other international markets.
* Draft professional resumes, cover letters, and personalized job application content.
* Send candidate profiles directly to recruiters, hiring managers, and agencies through email and professional networks.
* Generate maximum interview opportunities by implementing effective profile marketing strategies.
* Coordinate interview scheduling and keep candidates informed about interview status, feedback, and next steps.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates and provide timely placement updates.
* Track applications, interviews, recruiter responses, and placement progress using Excel, CRM, or Google Sheets.
* Collaborate with recruiters, trainers, and internal teams to improve candidate placement success.
* Maintain accurate records of all marketing activities and placement metrics.

**Requirements**

* Fresher – 1 years of experience in Recruitment, Resume Marketing, Candidate Marketing, Placement Services, HR, or Sales (Freshers with excellent communication skills may also apply).
* Excellent English communication and written skills.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn, job portals, and online recruitment platforms.
* Ability to draft professional resumes, cover letters, and recruiter emails.
* Basic understanding of IT roles such as Java, Python, QA, Business Analyst, DevOps, Data Analyst, etc., is preferred.
* Strong organizational, follow\-up, and multitasking skills.
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple candidate profiles simultaneously.

**Date Posted:** 31 July 2026

**Job Title:** Business Analyst Intern

**Internship Duration:** 3 Months

**Employment Type:** Internship

**Work Mode:** Work From Office

**Working Hours:** Full\-Time

**Internship Type:** Performance\-Based Stipend Internship

**Job Description**

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Business Analyst Intern** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical and communication skills, with an interest in understanding business requirements, documenting processes, and working closely with clients and development teams on real\-time software projects.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Gather and analyze business requirements from clients and stakeholders.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), and Software Requirement Specifications (SRS).
* Conduct requirement gathering sessions and client meetings.
* Analyze existing business processes and suggest improvements.
* Create user stories, use cases, and process flow diagrams.
* Coordinate with UI/UX designers, developers, testers, and project managers.
* Track project progress and ensure requirements are clearly communicated.
* Perform market and competitor research.
* Assist in product planning and feature prioritization.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and documentation.
* Prepare project reports, presentations, and meeting minutes.
* Work on real\-time client projects.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Business Analysis concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to gather and document business requirements.
* Basic knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Knowledge of BRD, FRD, SRS, User Stories, and Use Cases.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Basic knowledge of SQL is an added advantage.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Good presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail.

We are a Family Office and Boutique Investment Advisory firm dedicated to managing capital through rigorous bottom\-up research and long\-term value creation. · Understanding of accounting principles and financial statements.

· Ability to convert financial data into actionable business insights.

· High attention to detail with ownership and curiosity

***What Success Looks Like for this role:***

· Leadership receives reliable monthly business dashboards.

· Meaningful insights on profitability, costs and cash flow.

· Budgeting and forecasting processes become structured.

· Finance reporting becomes faster, clearer and more automated.

· Recommendations influence business decisions.

***Qualifications and Requirements:***

· CA aspirants (currently pursuing CA) can also apply

· Depends on previous experience; no bar for the right candidate

title: Member Technical Staff
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------


Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost\-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


As a member of the Siemens PowerPro core R\&D team, you will develop the software engines that power RTL and gate\-level power estimation. Your focus will be on driving the architecture of new features, building applications to aid power analysis, and developing high\-performance algorithms for simulation and power estimation. This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early\-career engineers to grow their technical expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and optimize core C\+\+ software applications for RTL and gate\-level power analysis and estimation.
* Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of new features within the power estimation product line.
* Design efficient algorithms to handle and process large simulation waveforms, switching activity data, and design netlists.
* Explore and integrate AI/ML techniques to improve the performance, scalability, and accuracy of core power estimation models.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver robust, high\-performance solutions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong foundational knowledge of C\+\+, STL, Data Structures, and Algorithms.
* Basic understanding of digital design concepts using Verilog or VHDL.
* 0\+ years of experience (freshers and entry\-level candidates welcome).
* Knowledge of scripting languages such as Tcl, Python, Perl, Sed, or Awk is a plus.
* Familiarity with EDA tools, logic simulation, or hardware waveform formats is desirable.

**Why Us**
----------


We are Siemens:


At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.


You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

--------------------------


Siemens is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate unlawfully on the grounds of age, disability, gender assignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and parental status, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or trade union membership. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Performance Testing Consultant (Mid Level)
description:
* Education: Graduation in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of hands on experience in performance testing and performance engineering for web or enterprise applications.
* Strong expertise in LoadRunner for scripting, scenario design, execution, and analysis.
* Proven experience in end to end Performance Testing (load, stress, endurance, spike) including test planning and execution.
* Solid background in Performance Engineering, including bottleneck identification, tuning recommendations, and capacity considerations.
* Practical experience using Dynatrace (or similar APM tools) for monitoring, tracing, and root cause analysis during performance tests.
* Hands on experience with Cloud Performance Testing for applications hosted on public or private cloud environments.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills to interact with cross functional and client teams.
* Design, plan, and execute end to end performance test strategies (load, stress, endurance, scalability) for complex enterprise and cloud based applications.
* Develop, parameterize, and maintain robust LoadRunner scripts, scenarios, and workloads aligned with business usage patterns, including advanced correlation, parameterization, think time modeling, error handling, custom logic, and data driven frameworks.
* Perform in depth performance analysis using Dynatrace and other monitoring tools to identify bottlenecks across application, database, network, and infrastructure layers.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to define performance scope, SLAs/SLOs, KPIs, and success criteria, interpret performance results, diagnose root causes, and recommend tuning and optimization strategies.
* Lead performance engineering activities, including capacity planning, sizing, and performance modeling for on premise and cloud environments, with a strong focus on microservices, REST APIs, async workflows, and batch processing.
* Conduct cloud performance testing across major platforms (e.g., autoscaling, elasticity, resilience), validating SLAs and non functional requirements, and evaluating limits/requests, node saturation, and cluster level constraints.
* Prepare clear, data driven performance reports, dashboards, and presentations for technical and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical findings in a concise and business relevant manner.
* Guide project teams on performance best practices throughout the SDLC and support shift left performance testing approaches, including early requirements clarification and performance risk identification.
* Mentor junior team members in performance testing techniques, tools usage, and analysis methods, fostering a self driven, ownership mindset within the team.
* Independently identify performance work items, define approaches, and execute performance engagements end to end, including test plan creation, scenario design, data modeling, and dashboard setup.
* Drive performance analysis and bottleneck identification across the full stack (application, JVM/GC, database, infrastructure, and container platforms) without waiting for direction, providing concrete tuning recommendations.

title: Desktop Support Engineer L1
description:
We are looking for a Desktop Support Engineer (L1\) to provide first\-level technical support for the cinema theatre's IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining desktops, laptops, printers, POS systems, networking devices, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 technical support for desktop, laptop, and peripheral issues.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows operating systems and software applications.
* Support POS systems, ticketing counters, kiosks, and payment devices.
* Install and maintain printers, scanners, barcode scanners, and biometric devices.
* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and network connectivity issues.
* Configure and support email clients (Outlook) and Microsoft Office applications.
* Perform hardware installation, replacement, and preventive maintenance.
* Create and manage user accounts, passwords, and access permissions.
* Respond to IT support tickets within the defined SLA.
* Coordinate with senior IT engineers or vendors for complex issues.
* Maintain IT asset inventory and documentation.
* Ensure antivirus, software updates, and system security are up to date.
* Provide technical support during movie releases, weekends, and special events when required.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of Windows 10/11 operating systems.
* Basic understanding of LAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience with desktop hardware, printers, and peripherals.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office 365 and Outlook.
* Basic knowledge of Active Directory is an advantage.
* Good troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* Certifications such as A\+, N\+, CCNA, or Microsoft certifications are an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **Freshers or 0–2 years** of experience in Desktop Support / IT Support.
* Experience in multiplexes, retail, hospitality, or customer\-facing environments is preferred.

**Preferred Candidate**

* Strong problem\-solving ability.
* Customer\-focused attitude.
* Team player with good interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts.

title: TSR - JOG
description:
**Job Title** **Territory Service Representative – Operations** **Function** **Operations** **Reports To**  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable) **Location** **Branch / Service Centre (Location Agnostic)** **Travel Required** **25%****50%****75%****þ** **About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

 **Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

 **Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

 availability failover.

title: Level Designer - Unity
description:
**About 8Chili** 




 8Chili is building the digital workforce operating system for pharmaceutical manufacturing, a connected suite of tools that trains, guides, and uplifts the people on the shop floor. Our products span immersive VR and AR training, AI\-powered shop\-floor assistance, and modern learning platforms, all built toward one goal: enhancing the way the pharma workforce learns and works.
 



 Immersive training is one of the most powerful surfaces in that ecosystem, and it's where this role lives. As our Level Designer, you'll craft the VR environments operators step into: spaces that feel real, read clearly, and hold up under close inspection in a headset, so people can train safely and repeatably before ever touching a live line.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design and build training environments in Unity, laying out spaces, staging equipment, and guiding the user's attention through the scene.
* Own lighting: Set up and optimize lighting to make environments believable and performant on standalone VR hardware.
* Work with materials and textures to give surfaces the right look and feel, balancing visual fidelity against performance.
* Assemble scenes from 3D assets, tuning placement, scale, and composition for clarity and immersion.
* Collaborate with developers, artists, and subject\-matter experts to translate real manufacturing settings into training\-ready spaces.



  





**How this role grows** 




 You'll start by owning environments, lighting, and materials. Over time, you'll grow into contributing on the simulation side — the interactive logic that turns a well\-built space into a scenario that actually teaches. Our intention is for you to master both crafts: the environment
 *and* 
 the experience.
 



  





**What you bring** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with lighting in Unity and how to keep frame rates high.
* Solid working knowledge of materials and textures in Unity.
* Comfortable and productive in the Unity game engine day to day.
* Basic knowledge of 3D asset design and how assets move through a pipeline.
* An eye for spatial flow, composition, and how people move through and read a space.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to VR/AR development or optimizing for standalone headsets.
* Familiarity with tools like Maya, Blender, Substance, and other modeling/texturing tools.



  





**What we offer** 



* ₹30,000/month
* The chance to shape how thousands of operators learn, on a product already deployed with leading pharma companies.
* A small, fast\-moving team where your work ships.

description:
Job Description – QC MicrobiologistAbout the Company

Liquimine LLP is a rapidly growing beverage manufacturing company specializing in Carbonated Soft Drinks (CSD), Packaged Drinking Water, and Alkaline Water. We are committed to manufacturing safe, high\-quality products by maintaining stringent Quality Management Systems and GMP practices.

We are looking for a dedicated and detail\-oriented QC Microbiologist to strengthen our Quality Control Department at our manufacturing facility in Manor, Palghar.

Key ResponsibilitiesMicrobiological Testing

* Perform routine microbiological analysis of raw water, treated water, process water, finished products, and environmental samples.
* Conduct Total Plate Count (TPC), Yeast \& Mold Count, Coliform, E. coli, and other microbiological analyses as per BIS/FSSAI standards.
* Carry out environmental monitoring of production and laboratory areas.
* Perform swab testing of equipment, filling lines, packaging areas, and personnel hygiene.

Laboratory Operations

* Prepare microbiological media, reagents, and culture solutions.
* Maintain microbial cultures and reference organisms.
* Sterilize laboratory glassware, media, and equipment using autoclaves.
* Ensure proper calibration and maintenance of microbiology laboratory instruments.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Maintain accurate laboratory records, test reports, and microbiology logs.
* Review microbiological results and immediately report any out\-of\-specification (OOS) findings.
* Prepare trend analysis reports for microbial monitoring.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, HACCP, FSSAI, and internal Quality Management Systems.
* Support internal and external quality audits.

Quality Assurance Support

* Participate in investigations related to microbial contamination.
* Assist in CAPA implementation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate with Production and QA departments for corrective and preventive actions.
* Verify cleaning and sanitation effectiveness.

General Responsibilities

* Maintain laboratory cleanliness and safety.
* Ensure proper disposal of microbiological waste.
* Follow all safety protocols and PPE requirements.
* Perform any additional quality\-related tasks assigned by the Quality Manager.

Candidate RequirementsEducational Qualification

* B.Sc./M.Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

Experience

* 1–5 years of experience in microbiological testing within the beverage, food, pharmaceutical, dairy, or packaged drinking water industry.
* Freshers with strong laboratory knowledge may also be considered.

Technical Skills

* Good understanding of microbiological testing methods.
* Knowledge of GMP, GLP, HACCP, FSSAI, and BIS requirements.
* Familiarity with aseptic techniques and laboratory best practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and documentation.

Desired Skills

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* High attention to detail.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and under production timelines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

At BeastLife, we're looking for a data\-driven Associate Product Manager who will own Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) across our mobile app and website. This role is ideal for someone who can combine product thinking, customer insights, experimentation, and analytics to improve the complete customer journey—from acquisition to repeat purchases.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 



* Own and improve conversion funnels across the BeastLife mobile app and Shopify website.
* Plan, execute, and analyse A/B tests to optimise landing pages, product pages, checkout, and user flows.
* Identify user drop\-offs using analytics tools and recommend data\-backed improvements.
* Work closely with Design, Tech, Marketing, CRM, Growth, and Business teams to launch high\-impact features.
* Drive product decisions using customer behaviour, heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel analysis.
* Improve customer retention through personalised journeys, CRM campaigns, and lifecycle automation.
* Optimise onboarding, checkout experience, subscription flows, and repeat purchase journeys.
* Monitor product KPIs such as Conversion Rate, AOV, CAC, Retention, LTV, Cart Abandonment, and Revenue.
* Collaborate with Shopify developers to improve store performance and user experience.
* Stay updated with CRO best practices, e\-commerce trends, and AI\-driven optimisation tools.



  






 Required Skills \& Experience
 



* 2–5 years of Product Management, Growth Product, or CRO experience in a D2C or E\-commerce company.
* Strong understanding of Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, Mobile Apps, and Web Products.
* Experience with GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of customer journeys, CRM, user segmentation, and lifecycle marketing.
* Ability to interpret data, define hypotheses, and prioritise experiments.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and driving product execution.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.



  






 Preferred Background
 





 Candidates from leading D2C, E\-commerce, Consumer Tech, or App\-first brands are highly preferred.
 




  






 Why Join BeastLife?
 



* Own high\-impact product decisions.
* Build products used by millions of fitness enthusiasts.
* Work directly with leadership on growth initiatives.
* Fast\-paced, ownership\-driven culture with rapid learning opportunities.

**Support Developer \- Frontend (Android)** 




**MishiPay** 




**Bangalore** 




**Salary plus 20% bonus** 




**Unlimited Holidays** 




**Various shift patterns needed to support international customers** 




  





**About Us** 




**About MishiPay** 





 MishiPay is a global leader in
 
**next\-generation checkout technology,** 

 enabling seamless in\-store purchases via shoppers’ own smartphones or our minimalist, low capex kiosks.
 





 We provide a complete checkout ecosystem \- spanning
 
**self\-checkout, Mobile POS, Click \& Collect** 

 and traditional tills \- allowing retailers to run their entire store checkout operation on MishiPay.
 





 Our technology reduces operating costs, increases basket size and visit frequency, lowers abandonment, and unlocks rich, real\-time customer data, delivering both immediate commercial impact and deeper insight into the in\-store customer journey. We now have major international retail customers in the UK, Europe, Middle East and the USA, and we’re expanding!
 




  





**About The Role** 





 We are looking for a skilled Android Front\-End Developer to design, develop, and maintain high\-quality Android applications. The role involves building intuitive and responsive user interfaces, integrating backend services, optimising application performance, and collaborating closely with Product, Design, QA, and Backend Engineering teams to deliver seamless mobile experiences. This is not a senior role, but we are looking for someone who has at least a year of Android and Kotlin experience, who is willing to learn and develop.
 





 We’re looking for an individual to cover various shift patterns to support the US, Australian and EMEA customers, over 5 days/nights a week, including Sundays. The night\-time shift will benefit from a shift allowance.
 




  





**About You** 




**You'll have up to two years experience as an Android Front\-End Developer with strong expertise in Kotlin and modern Android development. Ideally, you'll have experience supporting production applications, troubleshooting issues, and working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver an exceptional user experience.** 





 Not only will you be technically proficient, but you'll also
 
**possess excellent English communication skills** 

 , as you'll be collaborating with our international customers and internal stakeholders to support MishiPay implementations.
 





 The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose, XML\-based UI development, REST APIs, and modern Android architecture (MVVM/Clean Architecture). You'll be comfortable debugging complex issues, optimising application performance, and communicating effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders in a fast\-paced Agile environment.
 





 If you're a startup enthusiast who is passionate about solving complex problems and wants to learn something new everyday, we'd absolutely love to speak to you!
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain Android applications using Kotlin and Java.
* Build modern user interfaces using Jetpack Compose while supporting and maintaining legacy XML\-based screens where required.
* Collaborate with Product, UX/UI Designers, Backend Developers, and QA teams to deliver high\-quality mobile features.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party SDKs into Android applications.
* Implement scalable application architecture following MVVM and Clean Architecture principles.
* Develop reusable UI components and ensure consistency across the application.
* Optimise application performance, responsiveness, and memory usage.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application defects and production issues.
* Implement local data storage using Room, DataStore, or SharedPreferences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following Android development best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.
* Develop and maintain unit tests and UI tests to ensure application reliability and quality.



  





**Required Experience​** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in solid Android application development.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
* Experience developing Android applications using both Jetpack Compose and XML\-based UI.
* Solid understanding of Android SDK, application lifecycle, Activities, Fragments, and Intents.
* Strong knowledge of MVVM architecture and Clean Architecture principles.
* Hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose, including state management, Material Design, Navigation Compose, and reusable composables.
* Experience working with XML layouts, ConstraintLayout, RecyclerView, ViewBinding, and the Navigation Component.
* Strong understanding of Kotlin Coroutines, Flow, StateFlow, and SharedFlow.
* Experience integrating REST APIs using Retrofit and OkHttp.
* Experience with local data persistence using Room, DataStore, or SharedPreferences.
* Hands\-on experience with Dependency Injection frameworks such as Hilt or Dagger.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
* Experience writing unit tests and UI tests.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment.



  





**Why MishiPay?** 





 You’ll work with an inspirational multi\-cultural team, based in our Dubai HQ, the US, London and Bangalore, who are redefining the retail industry globally. We offer a tight\-knit, collaborative and exciting work environment, coupled with the opportunity to see the apps we develop live in action within some of the world’s largest retailers, impacting the lives of millions of shoppers.
 




  





**We also offer:** 



* Bonuses
* Unlimited holidays
* Hybrid Working (36 days WFH a year)
* Monthly Employee Awards
* A small monthly training budget
* Company events
* Free lunch in Bangalore
* MacBook
* Career progression and a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in tech

title: Android Developer
description:
**About BJAK** 




 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
 



  





 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile\-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 



  





 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
 



  





 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 



  





 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 



  
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.
 



  





 This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
 



  





**What Will You Build** 



* Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI\-assisted user journeys.
* Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.
* Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.
* Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.
* Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.
* Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.
* Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.
* Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.
* Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.
* Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.



  
 



**The Bar** 




 We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
 



  





**The Role Is Not For** 



* Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
* Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
* People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
* Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
* People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.



  
 



**Location** 




 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
 
 India
 
 .
 



  





**Language** 




 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 



  





**Interview Process** 




 Our process is designed to move fast:
 



  




1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role\-specific interview
3. CEO / final round



  





 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Staff Facilitator & Training Coordinator
description:
**Overview**
------------


The Facilitator \& Training Coordinator is a high\-impact, shared\-skill role that unifies live learning delivery and operational coordination into a single integrated position. You will facilitate ILT, VILT, and blended learning sessions that drive measurable behavior change; own end\-to\-end logistics, LMS administration, scheduling, and learner communications; and track Kirkpatrick L1–L2 data to fuel continuous improvement. The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity — equally energized by facilitating a dynamic virtual classroom and by building a clean tracking spreadsheet the next morning. They hold two truths simultaneously: great facilitation is a craft requiring preparation, presence, and adaptability; great coordination is a discipline requiring precision, proactivity, and follow\-through. Reports to the Facilitation Manager.

 **Responsibilities**

*Facilitation \& Learning Delivery*

* Deliver ILT and VILT sessions on customer service, product knowledge, communication skills, systems navigation, and role\-specific content across new hire onboarding, upskilling, and continuous learning programs
* Create an inclusive, participatory learning environment grounded in adult learning principles; use role plays, case studies, call simulations, and scenario\-based exercises (learners doing 80%, facilitator guiding 20%)
* Facilitate nesting and on\-the\-job practice with coaching, feedback, and structured debriefs before learners are released to production
* Adjust delivery in real time based on group energy and comprehension signals; provide 1:1 and small\-group coaching for learners needing reinforcement
* Partner with QA and Operations to align content with current KPIs, quality benchmarks, and performance standards

*Training Coordination \& Operations*

* Own end\-to\-end scheduling of sessions — calendar setup, learner invitations, rescheduling, cancellations; serve as day\-of logistics lead (virtual session setup, breakout rooms, real\-time issue resolution)
* Manage learner enrollment, waitlists, completions, and certifications in the LMS; maintain accurate, audit\-ready records and distribute compliance reports
* Prepare and version\-control training materials, workbooks, facilitator guides, and job aids; coordinate supplies, vendors, and invoicing
* Draft pre\-training communications, reminders, pre\-work instructions, and post\-training follow\-ups; distribute evaluation surveys within 24 hours of session close

*Data, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement*

  

* Track and report attendance, no\-show rates, completions, learner satisfaction (L1\), and post\-training assessment results (L2\) on a weekly/monthly cadence
* Identify patterns (scheduling conflicts, low\-completion cohorts, engagement trends) and proactively surface insights; maintain training calendars, trackers, and dashboards
* Participate in post\-session debriefs and contribute to the Facilitator Community of Practice

 **Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in HR, Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 3–5 years facilitating training in contact center, customer service, financial services, or similar environments, with demonstrated success in blended learning (ILT, VILT, eLearning)
* 1–3 years of training coordination, learning operations, HR administration, or event/program management
* Experience with at least one enterprise LMS (Workday Learning, Docebo, Cornerstone OnDemand, or equivalent)
* Proficiency with virtual platforms (Zoom, Teams, Webex, Google Meet) and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication; comfort compiling and presenting clean, accurate metrics

*Preferred*

  

* Certifications: ATD (CPTD/APTD), Kirkpatrick Four Levels®, ICF, or equivalent
* Familiarity with financial services, tax, accounting, or small business software (QuickBooks, Intuit product suite)
* Exposure to adult learning principles (Knowles), ADDIE/SAM, and Kirkpatrick L1–L4 evaluation
* Coaching background with struggling/resistant learners; experience with Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira

  

Footer
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Identity Specialist
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  

Who Are We?
  
  

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  

Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  

Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  

A Day in the Life of Identity Specialist!
  
  

This role of Identity Specialist is responsible for the comprehensive implementation and operational management of our identity and access management solutions, with a primary focus on ensuring robust identity protection across the enterprise, involving leading the transformation and optimization of critical identity infrastructure, collaborating with security and IT teams, and driving the adoption of best practices to secure user access and privileged accounts.
  
  

In this role, You will..
  
  

**Be responsible for the following:**  

* Lead the architecture, implementation, and administration of core identity services including Active Directory (AD) and Entra ID (Azure AD), ensuring high availability, security, and performance.
* Manage the Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) lifecycle, including certificate issuance, revocation, and integration with various enterprise applications and systems.
* Design, deploy, and maintain privileged access management (PAM) solutions, specifically CyberArk, to safeguard sensitive credentials and manage elevated access efficiently.
* Implement and manage Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) strategies and solutions, enhancing security for both on\-premises and cloud\-based resources.
* Develop and enforce robust account management processes, including provisioning, de\-provisioning, and regular access reviews, to align with security policies and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for all Identity and Access Management (IAM) related technologies and initiatives, providing guidance and support to various IT and business units.
* Collaborate closely with Cyber Security, and other IT teams to integrate identity solutions, respond to security incidents, and maintain a strong security posture.
* Strategize, plan, and execute projects related to identity system enhancements, upgrades, and integrations from conception to successful Go\-live, ensuring a smooth transition into operations.
* Monitor and report on the health, performance, and security of identity infrastructure and services, ensuring service delivery meets defined SLAs and business requirements.


What are we looking for?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related study, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with a focus on identity protection, privileged access management, and directory services in large enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated expert\-level proficiency with Active Directory (AD), Entra ID (Azure AD), and their associated services (e.g., federation, synchronization).
* In\-depth hands\-on experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) management and certificate lifecycle.
* Proven experience in implementing, configuring, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, specifically CyberArk.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) technologies and deployment strategies.
* Familiarity with identity governance principles, access reviews, and compliance frameworks.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams and communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated effective oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strategic thinking with a proactive, results\-oriented approach and a passion for innovation in identity security.


Nice to Have
  
  

* Preferable: Experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools for reporting, dashboard creation, and analytics related to identity data and security metrics.


What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future\-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings \- personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long\-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment


**Good to know:** The Recruitment Process
  
  

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager


We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

A Day in the Life of SecOps Manager!
  
  

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong SecOps Manager to strengthen the cybersecurity posture of our server, virtual machine, cloud workload, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  
  

Reporting to the CSD Zone Lead, the SecOps Manager will lead security operations, vulnerability remediation, audit\-action tracking, cloud\-security posture management, and resilience activities across on\-premise and multi\-cloud environments.
  
  

You will work closely with Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, IT Operations, Global Cyber Security, managed\-service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity risks are identified, prioritised, remediated, and clearly reported.
  
  

In this role, You will.
  
  

**Be responsible for the following:**  

Security Operations \& Risk Mitigation
  
* Lead security operations for servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and associated infrastructure services.
* Oversee the effectiveness and coverage of security technologies such as Tanium, server EDR, anti\-malware, CWPP, vulnerability\-management, and security\-monitoring tools.
* Drive the remediation of vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, unsupported technologies, and security\-control gaps.
* Define and track SecOps KPIs and KRIs, including vulnerability ageing, patch compliance, workload\-security coverage, remediation timelines, and risk exceptions.
* Prepare operational dashboards and risk reports for cybersecurity governance and leadership teams.


Vulnerability, Patch \& Obsolescence Management
  
* Own the end\-to\-end vulnerability\-management lifecycle for servers, VMs, infrastructure platforms, and cloud workloads.
* Coordinate vulnerability identification, triage, prioritisation, remediation planning, exception management, validation, and closure.
* Orchestrate lifecycle patching across on\-premise, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
* Track and manage technology\-obsolescence risks related to operating systems, middleware, databases, runtimes, virtualization platforms, and infrastructure components.
* Apply a risk\-based approach considering severity, exploitability, asset criticality, business impact, and external exposure.


Cloud Security
  
* Manage cloud\-security posture and remediation activities across AliCloud ,Azure, GCP and AWS environments.
* Demonstrate hands\-on experience with AliCloud technologies and security controls, including ECS, VPC, RAM, security groups, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and cloud\-configuration security.
* Coordinate remediation of CSPM findings and cloud misconfigurations.
* Partner with Cloud and Platform teams to improve identity controls, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, security baselines, and workload hardening.
* Ensure server, VM, cloud workload, and security\-relevant configuration information is complete and accurate in the CMDB.


Security Audit Tracking \& Mitigation
  
* Manage the tracking and remediation of findings from internal and external audits, cybersecurity assessments, penetration tests, cloud\-security reviews, compliance reviews, and operational\-risk assessments.
* Maintain a central audit\-action tracker covering action owner, due date, remediation evidence, risk status, and escalation requirements.
* Validate evidence before closure and ensure actions address the root cause of the identified control gap.
* Report on open, overdue, high\-risk, and recurring audit findings, highlighting trends and required management decisions.


DRP \& Resilience Management
  
* Own and maintain the annual Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) calendar.
* Coordinate DRP exercises, recovery tests, failover tests, tabletop exercises, evidence collection, lessons learned, and remediation follow\-up.
* Work with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Business Continuity teams to improve recovery readiness, backup controls, resilience, and operational continuity.
* Ensure gaps identified during DRP tests are tracked, assigned, and closed within agreed timelines.


On\-Demand Cybersecurity Initiatives
  
* Lead or support targeted cybersecurity initiatives based on business, audit, technology, regulatory, or risk requirements.
* Typical initiatives may include Java compliance, cyber\-process improvement, server hardening, cloud\-security remediation, security\-tool onboarding, CMDB improvement, privileged\-access remediation, audit remediation, and cloud\-migration security assessments.
* Manage action plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholder communication, and delivery reporting.


AI, Automation \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  
* Experience applying automation and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve cybersecurity operations, such as vulnerability prioritisation, alert enrichment, remediation tracking, audit\-evidence collection, compliance reporting, and security\-dashboard automation.
* Understanding of responsible use of AI in security operations, including validation of AI\-generated outputs, data protection, access controls, traceability, and human oversight for risk\-based decisions.
* Practical experience with automation and orchestration tools, scripting, APIs, or workflow platforms to reduce manual operational activities and improve remediation speed and consistency.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security practices, including secure provisioning, configuration validation, policy\-as\-code, secrets management, version control, and automated compliance checks.
* Experience reviewing or supporting IaC technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, ARM templates, Bicep, Alibaba Cloud Resource Orchestration Service (ROS), or equivalent tools.


What are we looking for?
  
  

Education \& Experience
  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity operations, server security, cloud security, vulnerability management, IT infrastructure security, audit remediation, or IT risk.
* Demonstrated experience managing security for servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Proven experience with vulnerability remediation, patch\-management coordination, audit tracking, and security\-control reporting.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale, geographically distributed, or managed\-services environments is preferred.


Certifications Candidates should hold at least one relevant cybersecurity or cloud\-security certification, such as:
  
* CISM, CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security\+

processing practices and SLA’s

incoming calls/incidents

Here is a complete, professional \*\*HR Manager (Generalist)\*\* job description tailored to your requirements:

\# Job Title: Human Resources (HR) Manager

\*\*Location:\*\* Jaipur, Rajasthan (On\-site)

\*\*Experience Required:\*\* 2\+ Years

\*\*Salary:\*\* ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 per month

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-time

\#\# \*\*Job Overview\*\*

We are seeking a versatile and proactive \*\*HR Manager\*\* to oversee end\-to\-end HR operations across our Jaipur office. As a 360\-degree HR Generalist, you will handle everything from talent acquisition and onboarding to payroll administration, compliance, employee engagement, and offboarding.

If you are an energetic HR professional who thrives in managing all aspects of human resources independently, this role is for you.

\#\# \*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

\#\#\# \*\*1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment\*\*

\* Manage full\-cycle recruitment for various internal roles (job postings, resume screening, interviewing, and scheduling).

\* Coordinate with team leads to understand hiring needs and draft precise job descriptions.

\* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), local vendors, and employee referrals.

\#\#\# \*\*2\. Onboarding \& Offboarding\*\*

\* Conduct seamless onboarding, orientation, and document verification for new hires.

\* Manage probation reviews and confirmation processes.

\* Handle complete offboarding procedures, including exit interviews, handover processes, and full \& final (F\&F) settlements.

\#\#\# \*\*3\. Payroll \& Attendance Management\*\*

\* Track daily attendance, leaves, shift schedules, and late marks using HRMS / biometric software.

\* Prepare monthly payroll data, including salary calculations, deductions, incentives, and leave encashment.

\* Coordinate with the accounting department for timely disbursement of salaries.

\#\#\# \*\*4\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Operations\*\*

\* Maintain employee master data, physical personnel files, and HR database records.

\* Ensure compliance with local employment laws and statutory regulations (PF, ESIC, PT, Labour Law compliance).

\* Formulate, update, and enforce company HR policies, code of conduct, and attendance guidelines.

\#\#\# \*\*5\. Employee Engagement \& Culture\*\*

\* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, birthday celebrations, festival events, and team outings.

\* Act as a reliable point of contact for employee grievances, resolving workplace conflicts smoothly and impartially.

\* Drive employee retention strategies and foster a positive workplace culture.

\#\#\# \*\*6\. Performance Management System (PMS)\*\*

\* Facilitate quarterly/annual performance appraisal cycles across teams.

\* Assist managers in key performance indicator (KPI) tracking and goal setting.

\* Identify training needs and organize learning/development sessions for staff.

\#\# \*\*Key Qualifications \& Skills\*\*

\* \*\*Education:\*\* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).

\* \*\*Experience:\*\* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in full\-scope HR management (Generalist profile).

\* \*\*Location:\*\* Based in or willing to relocate to \*\*Jaipur\*\*.

\* \*\*Technical Skills:\*\* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word), HRMS software, and job portal navigation.

\* \*\*Communication:\*\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

\* \*\*Interpersonal Skills:\*\* Strong conflict\-resolution, negotiation, and people\-management capabilities.

\#\# \*\*What We Offer\*\*

\* \*\*Salary:\*\* ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 / month (based on candidate experience and interview performance).

\* Competitive growth opportunities and leadership visibility.

\* Supportive, fast\-paced work environment.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Industry: HVAC (Heating, Ventilation \& Air Conditioning)

We are seeking an experienced Service Manager – Customer Value Services (CVS) with a strong HVAC background to lead the after\-sales service operations. The candidate will be responsible for service delivery, annual maintenance contracts (AMC), preventive and breakdown maintenance, customer relationship management, technical support, spare parts planning, and service revenue growth while ensuring high customer satisfaction.

Manage day\-to\-day HVAC service operations across assigned locations.

Lead and mentor a team of Service Engineers and Technicians.

Ensure timely execution of preventive maintenance, breakdown services, and emergency support.

Drive AMC/CMC sales, contract renewals, and service revenue.
