Monitor service KPIs, response time, turnaround time (TAT), first\-time fix rate, and customer feedback.

Coordinate with Sales, Projects, Procurement, and Technical Support teams.

Ensure availability of critical spare parts and inventory management.

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring equipment failures.

Prepare MIS reports, service dashboards, and monthly performance reports.

Ensure compliance with safety standards and company SOPs.

Support installation, commissioning, and warranty services when required.

Handle customer escalations professionally and implement corrective actions.

Required Skills

Strong technical knowledge of HVAC systems (VRF, VRV, Chillers, AHU, FCU, DX Systems, Package Units, Cooling Towers, Ventilation Systems).

Experience in AMC/CMC management and after\-sales service.

Knowledge of HVAC troubleshooting and maintenance practices.

Team leadership and people management skills.

Excellent customer relationship management.

Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation.

Knowledge of service management software/ERP/CRM.

Strong communication, negotiation, and reporting skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and service teams simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

Experience in HVAC OEMs, HVAC contracting companies, or MEP organizations.

Exposure to commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, healthcare, hospitality, and data center HVAC systems.

Experience in service business development and contract management.

AMC/CMC Renewal Rate

Technician Productivity

Team Performance \& Safety Compliance

title: Deputy Manager - Sales HR
description:
Job Title / Designation: Business Partner HR (Sales)
   

  

 Department: Human Resource Functional
   

  

 Reporting to: General Manager \- HR, Administratively Reporting to: Head of Sales
   

  

 Location: Multiple
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Build strong connect with sales team to effectively partner in building the right values\-based culture.
   

  

 Responsible for driving core HR processes efficiently and effectively with the sales team to create healthy work environment.
   

  

 Ensure capability building for the sales team as per development needs \& company priorities and create a performance\-oriented work culture
   

  

 Drive effective communication and engagement to ensure that the team is motivated to deliver.  Manage Employee related Headcount, tracking and expenses.
   

  

 Ensure Bench Planning and hiring of right talent to drive the sales agenda for the region
   

  

 Data collection, consolidating and analyzing to draw up regular reports to help drive relevant action.
   

  

 Provide effective HR/ personnel/ administrative support to the region sales team
   

  

**Primary Roles \& Accountabilities**
 Core HR Processes: Ensure flawless execution of the following Core people processes
   

  

 Performance Management process –
   

  

* Objective Setting of the entire team are SMART \& in line with AOP, business \& people priorities.
* Midyear Review\- Ensure MYR is done between manager \& employee to provide directions on the progress
* Annual Appraisal\- Ensure PDRs are well written, onus for calibration of the region team and fitting the bell curve. Compilation of data to ensure high quality Calibration and pay for performance
* Focal Point Discussion\- Ensure this happens between manager, employee \& HR and employee is provided feedback with relevant data and developmental inputs.


 Management Connect Survey – Ensure participation by providing correct data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to share scores \& drive action planning.
   

  

 Org. Health survey – Ascertain employee participation by ensuring accuracy in data and effective administration and follow\-up with sales team. Work closely with the managers to bring out insights, create \& drive action planning.
   

  

 People Planning process – Coach the team and build CDAPs for the region team. Support the RM in building people plan for the region team and ensure that the movements are in line with the people planning process. Implement the development action plan in line with employees CDAP.
   

  

 PMP Survey – Ensure participation of the region team and take corrective action as per employee feedback.
   

  

 Staffing
   

  

* Responsible for recruitment in the Region – Channel Wise (Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, Wholesale, Up Country) supporting region business plan in each of the channel up to L05 in the region. (Sales Trainee to Area Sales Manager)
* Own the staffing and recruitment process from end to end (manpower planning, sourcing, joining \-\-\> on Boarding) for upto L05 level. Support the induction for L6\+ population for the region.
* Internal Job Posting – Own up the IJP for the region (L01\- L05 level)
* Maintain employee number as per the AOP and track it on a monthly basis
* Ensure minimal man\-day loss on account of employee exit and replacement, quick turnaround.
* Bring in diversity of talent in the team by hiring diverse workforce from different facets.
* Ensure that the Exit interview is done and analysis of same is fed back to the relevant process/ system.


 Employee Engagement \& Culture Building
   

  

* Be an employee champion \- Reach out to the frontline to ensure good connect and resolve frontline issues in minimum time.
* Own the R\&R for the region – ROH as per plan, Area Manager of the month, Customer Executive of the month, family day, creating excitement by creating/rolling out appropriate regional contests (rollout of national contests as per BU plan)
* Partner with the RM to nominate the high performing sales employees for regional/national/international ROH
* Own up the engagement agenda for the region as per the agreed plan and ensure high employee involvement.
* Set up appropriate two way communication channel with the frontline.
* Ensure that all relevant HR processes are communicated to the frontline and build a strong PepsiCo Employer Proposition.
* Drive the organizational Values and Code of Conduct to the frontline through appropriate communication, highlighting deviation and being the role model themselves.


 Capability Building
   

  

 Drive organization capability agenda in partnership with RM \& BU HR \- Ensure employee development as per development needs highlighted thru Performance management process \& People planning. Follow 70:20:10 principle.
   

  

 Create Performance improvement plan with RM for the people in concern area.
   

  

 Implementation of change initiatives and supporting continuous improvement in sales function.
   

  

 Facilitate delivery of development and training activities for employees and monitor effectiveness for business results as per the requirement.
   

  

 Administration and MIS
   

  

* Generate, own and maintain various People Process reports/ records/ analysis and must Win Battles Report. Send the reports to HO as per timelines and as required and drive appropriate action plans in partnership with RM \& BUHR
* Ensure that relevant HR Admin support is provided to the employees in a timely manner
* Own up the Third Party Resources (TDO\- SPO, Admin resources): Process Ownership ( T\&E, Salary, Imprest, Grievance handling, complete control and processing)


**Skill/Attributes/Work Experience**
* Ability to anticipate, prioritize and Multitask
* Interpersonal relations – Collaboration and expectation management of the line
* Expert in productive communication – Be able to influence and impact without formal power
* Know the business – Good understanding of the sales levers
* Functional Excellence \- Good understanding of HR processes
* Process Orientation – Be able to maintain process integrity
* High Value Orientation with strong Drive and Execution orientation
* High Learning Agility \& high Customer Orientation

title: HR Service Delivery Associate
description:
**Skill required:** Workforce Data Admin \- HR Service Delivery  

**Designation:** HR Service Delivery Associate  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**1 to 3 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** This role provides client services for Employee \& Org Data Mgmt which may include from hire to retire services. It follows all administration processes to ensure tasks are completed correctly and resource efficiencies are maintained. The role works closely with Delivery Services Management to identify and escalate client issues, obtain and confirm pending information/documentation, and add and amend transaction information to client/systems responding to changes (via e\-mail/telephone) to maintain current visible HR records for the client. • Read, understand, and analyze client processes as per the business rules. • Execute the full range of the process accurately and timely as a hands\-on processor. • Escalate issues and seek advice when faced with complex issues/problems. • Follow Work Instructions while processing. • Highlight any anomalies in Work Instructions/process documentation to the SME/Leads. • Participate in client conference calls, where required, and manage appropriate documentation. • Perform “Root Cause Analysis” on issues faced and suggest appropriate corrective action for current remediation and future control. • Propose process improvement ideas to reduce time, improve accuracy, or enhance controls. • Understand existing matrices in the process, how they are measured, and improvise the measurement system to make it more effective and transparent. • Update process metrics on a daily basis and maintain MIS. • Demonstrate the highest level of customer service. • Pay close attention to detail and follow through to resolve any outstanding issues. • Ensure both own and related tasks are completed. • Update client applications accurately and quickly in accordance with the appropriate User Guides. • Ensure assigned tasks are completed accurately in a timely fashion. • Ensure and maintain the security and confidentiality of client data. • Actively participate in team activities and organizational initiatives.  

**What are we looking for?** • Strong customer orientation \- high level of responsiveness to urgent requests or troubleshooting. • Resilient and able to work under pressure. • Organization \& prioritization skills to deliver as per deadlines. • Attention to detail \& quality driven – in communications and all system transactions. • Demonstrate high levels of confidentiality. • Teamwork \& collaboration. • Multi\-cultural awareness. • Flexible to work in shifts. • Knowledge of Employee \& Org data Mgmt Processes (New Hires, Exit, Job Changes, etc.). • Strong command of written and verbal English language. • Knowledge of MS Office/Excel Skills would be a plus. • Knowledge of SuccessFactors would be a plus.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines • Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor • You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments • The decisions that you make would impact your own work • You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**

  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast\-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.

  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future\-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting\-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.

 **About The Role**

  

We are looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented HR Generalist to manage end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle. The ideal candidate will be responsible for onboarding, employee data management, payroll coordination, leave administration, compliance, and HR audits. This role requires strong stakeholder management skills and hands\-on experience with HR systems, preferably Workday

 **What You’ll Do**

 **1\. Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle Management**

  

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding processes, including documentation, background verification, and induction.
* Ensure a seamless joining experience for new employees.
* Coordinate system access and required onboarding formalities.
* Maintain accurate employee records throughout the employee lifecycle.

 **2\. Exit Management**

  

* Handle resignation processes and employee exit formalities.
* Conduct exit interviews and maintain exit\-related documentation.
* Coordinate with payroll for timely processing of full and final settlements.
* Ensure proper closure of employee records and system access.

 **3\. HR Operations \& Workday Management**

  

* Manage and maintain employee data in Workday.
* Ensure data accuracy, system updates, and record maintenance.
* Generate HR reports and support dashboard requirements.
* Assist in HR system audits and process improvements.

 **4\. Absence \& Leave Management**

  

* Administer employee leave and attendance records.
* Ensure compliance with company leave policies.
* Address employee queries related to leave, attendance, and absence management.
* Maintain accurate leave balances and records.

 **5\. Payroll Coordination**

  

* Collaborate closely with the payroll team to provide monthly payroll inputs.
* Validate attendance, leave, and employee movement data.
* Ensure payroll information is accurate and submitted within deadlines.
* Support payroll audits and compliance activities.

 **6\. HR Audits \& Compliance**

  

* Support internal and external HR audits.
* Maintain HR documentation and records in line with company policies and statutory requirements.
* Assist in the preparation, review, and updating of HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and organizational standards.

 **Unleash your potential**

  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in HR Operations or HR Generalist roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday or other HRMS platforms.
* Strong understanding of onboarding, employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, and HR compliance.
* Experience supporting HR audits and maintaining employee records.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience working in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and HR compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and HR reporting.

 **Working at Bravura**

  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work\-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

  



**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental \& Health \& Safety**

  

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually \& Comply with all Company policies related to H\&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered

 **So, what’s next?**

  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.

  

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 0 to 5 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
Candidates with 0–1 year of experience should demonstrate capability through academic projects, internships, certifications, GitHub repositories, hackathons, prototypes, or hands\-on GenAI experiments.
  
Candidates with 2–5 years of experience should have hands\-on experience building, integrating, testing, or deploying GenAI, AI assistant, chatbot, RAG, automation, or agentic workflow solutions.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.
  
  

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**  

BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description:** 




 SplashData is a leading provider of security and productivity software applications for mobile professionals, businesses, and enterprise customers. The company’s flagship product, SplashID, has been the \#1 cross\-platform password manager for over a decade. SplashID is available on iOS, Android, Windows, Mac OS, and via the web, making it accessible across devices and platforms. Team members contribute to products that help users securely manage sensitive information while improving efficiency and digital safety.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 





 We are seeking a motivated Quality Engineer to join our team in Pune. In this role, your primary focus will be on ensuring the reliability, usability, and performance of our core suite of applications. You will be responsible for defining test strategies, executing manual test cases, and developing automated test scripts using modern testing frameworks.
 





 In this role, you will have the opportunity to deep\-dive into cross\-platform system testing and the development of sophisticated automated test frameworks. You will be instrumental in ensuring application reliability and performance across diverse environments, while receiving dedicated mentorship and support to master the nuances of testing legacy systems.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Manual Testing** 

 : Conduct thorough manual exploratory and functional testing across mobile, desktop, and web applications to identify defects and ensure a seamless user experience.
* **Automation Testing** 

 : Build, maintain, and scale automated test suites for our Flutter\-based applications to increase testing efficiency and coverage.
* **Legacy Application Testing** 

 : Develop a deep understanding of our legacy native applications to establish and maintain robust automated testing processes for long\-term stability.
* **Test Planning \& Bug Tracking** 

 : Create detailed test plans and cases, and manage the full defect lifecycle using tracking tools like JIRA to ensure all issues are resolved before release.
* **Collaboration** 

 : Work closely with the engineering manager, software engineers, quality engineers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineers to deliver clean user experiences.
* **Requirement Analysis** 

 : Participate in requirement analysis to ensure testability and clarity of project specifications.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* **Experience** 

 : 1–3 years of professional experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong emphasis on both manual and automated testing of web, mobile and desktop applications.
* **Networking** 

 : Strong understanding of HTTP protocols, JSON parsing, and experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman) and network monitoring to validate API responses and network traffic.
* **Testing Mindset** 

 : Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
* **Tooling** 

 : Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and industry\-standard debugging tools and hands\-on experience using profiling resources like Flutter DevTools, Xcode, and Android Studio to diagnose performance issues and memory leaks. Experience with cross\-browser and cross\-device testing platforms like BrowserStack.
* **Adaptability** 

 : A strong willingness to learn, explore, and establish automated testing protocols for older, legacy codebases (Objective\-C, Java, C\#/.NET), with provided team support.
* **Work Authorization \& Presence** 

 : Must be located in or willing to relocate to Pune and be able to work from our Pune office at least 2 days a week.



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Advanced experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Flutter Driver, Appium, Selenium, XCUITest).
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline integration for automated testing.
* Familiarity with performance testing metrics and monitoring tools for production stability.
* Experience with agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enhance development and testing productivity.



  





**Location:** 





 Pune, India (Hybrid role: minimum of 2 days per week in\-office)
 




  






 Candidates available to join immediately will be given priority.

description:
Business Growth Partner (Commission\-Based)About Marketing Talk

Marketing Talk is a full\-service digital marketing agency helping businesses grow through SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Social Media Marketing, Website Development, Branding, Local SEO, Video Marketing, and Creative Solutions.

We are expanding our Growth Partner Network and looking for passionate professionals who want to build a long\-term recurring income by helping businesses grow.

This is not a traditional salaried role. It is a performance\-based opportunity for ambitious individuals who want unlimited earning potential while working with an experienced digital marketing agency.

About the Role

As a Business Growth Partner, your primary responsibility is to generate new business opportunities, build your personal brand, and connect with potential clients.

You don't need to worry about project execution.

Marketing Talk will handle:

* Client onboarding
* Project execution
* Campaign management
* Website development
* SEO
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads
* Social Media Management
* Graphic Designing
* Video Editing
* Client Support \& Reporting

Your focus should be on acquiring clients and building long\-term relationships.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, Instagram, Email, Networking, Cold Outreach, and Personal Connections.
* Conduct online meetings with potential clients.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable digital marketing solutions.
* Build your personal brand by consistently sharing marketing\-related content.
* Create and upload your own short\-form videos (Reels/Shorts) and educational marketing content.
* Publish banners, posts, and valuable content on LinkedIn and/or Instagram.
* Build trust and credibility through your online presence.
* Coordinate with the Marketing Talk team whenever technical or project\-related support is required.

Who Can Apply?

We are looking for professionals who are serious about building a long\-term career in client acquisition.

Experienced Professionals

* Sales Professionals
* Business Development Executives
* Marketing Consultants
* Digital Marketing Professionals
* Freelancers
* Agency Professionals
* B2B Sales Experts

Freshers

Freshers are also welcome **only if you meet the following criteria:**

* Strong understanding of Digital Marketing.
* Confident in creating and publishing your own content.
* Comfortable recording your own videos and reels.
* Passionate about personal branding.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Eager to learn and grow.

Requirements

* Excellent spoken English and strong communication skills.
* Confidence in handling international client meetings.
* Good understanding of Digital Marketing Services.
* Basic knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Website Development, Social Media Marketing, Branding, and Lead Generation.
* Ability to confidently present ideas and build client relationships.
* Active on LinkedIn and/or Instagram.
* Willingness to consistently create and publish professional content.
* Self\-motivated, disciplined, and target\-driven.
* Professional attitude and long\-term mindset.

Training \& Support from Marketing Talk

You won't be working alone.

Our team will support and guide you throughout your journey.

We will help you with:

* Content planning and strategy.
* Banner and social media post designing.
* Video editing support for your reels and short\-form videos.
* Research guidance for marketing topics and content ideas.
* LinkedIn profile optimization.
* Personal branding guidance.
* Sales pitch guidance.
* Client meeting support whenever required.
* Company profile and marketing materials.
* Proposal and presentation support.
* Digital marketing training whenever needed.
* Complete project execution and client delivery.

You don't need to be a professional designer or video editor.

Our creative team will help you with designing, editing, research, and content guidance so you can focus on building your personal brand, acquiring clients, and growing your recurring income.

CompensationMonthly Services

Earn recurring monthly commission on every active monthly client you bring.

As long as your client continues working with Marketing Talk, you'll continue earning your commission every month.

Examples include:

* SEO
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads
* Social Media Marketing
* Local SEO
* Content Marketing
* Monthly Website Maintenance

One\-Time Projects

Earn a one\-time commission on projects such as:

* Website Development
* Logo Design
* Branding
* Mobile App Development
* Graphic Designing
* Video Editing
* Other one\-time digital services

Why Join Marketing Talk?

* Remote Work
* Flexible Working Hours
* No Fixed Salary Limit
* No Earning Limit
* Unlimited Growth Potential
* Recurring Monthly Income Opportunity
* Complete Backend Support
* Experienced Execution Team
* Professional Sales \& Marketing Resources
* Opportunity to build your own personal brand while working with a growing digital marketing agency.

Why This Opportunity is Different

Unlike traditional sales jobs, you're not just earning a one\-time commission.

You're building a recurring monthly income.

The more long\-term clients you acquire, the more your monthly earnings grow.

There is **no earning cap**—your success depends on the value you create and the relationships you build.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their:

* CV/Resume
* LinkedIn Profile
* Portfolio (if available)
* Introduction Video

**Email:** finix.rohit@gmail.com

**WhatsApp:** \+91 62392 44016

Please mention **"Business Growth Partner Application"** in your email subject or WhatsApp message.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

description:
**Job Title**

  

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

  

  

**Reports To**

  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)  



  

**Location**

  

**Branch / Service Centre (Location Agnostic)**

  

  

**Travel Required**

  

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operations Tech
   

  

 This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advanced data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Branch Executive
description:
**SALES OFFICER — JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Sales Officer — Gold Finance**

**Reports To:** Branch Manager / Assistant Branch Manager

**Supervises:** N/A — Individual Contributor

**Location:** Branch\-based with active field duty — local market coverage, doorstep visits, and lead follow\-up in the branch catchment area

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Officer is the frontline growth engine of the KGF branch — responsible for generating new gold loan customers, converting leads, driving disbursement volumes, and deepening relationships with existing customers for renewals and top\-ups. The SO operates both at the counter and in the field — visiting markets, households, and business establishments to create awareness and acquire customers. The role demands a proactive, self\-driven personality with strong local market knowledge, persuasion skills, and a genuine ability to build lasting customer trust on behalf of the KGF brand.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Lead Generation \& New Customer Acquisition**

* Generate new gold loan leads through field visits — markets, residential areas, commercial hubs — within the branch catchment.
* Conduct door\-to\-door campaigns and community events to build brand awareness and attract first\-time gold loan customers.
* Identify and target key customer segments — micro\-entrepreneurs, traders, farmers, homemakers, and self\-employed individuals.
* Build and maintain a personal lead pipeline — minimum lead targets to be met weekly as set by BM.
* Follow up on all assigned leads from the telecalling team within 24 hours — no lead left uncontacted beyond one business day.
* Collect customer references from every satisfied borrower and convert referrals into active loan accounts.
* Track lead\-to\-disbursement conversion rate; identify drop\-off points and report to BM with corrective action plan.

**B. Disbursement Target Achievement**

* Own individual monthly disbursement target — plan weekly activity to ensure on\-track achievement at all times.
* Coordinate with counter staff and ABM to ensure customer brought to branch is processed and disbursed same day.
* Drive renewal disbursements — proactively contact customers whose loans are due for renewal before the loan expiry date.
* Promote top\-up loans to customers with good repayment history — identify eligible accounts from ABM\-shared list.
* Submit daily disbursement activity report to BM — leads met, customers visited, disbursements achieved, pipeline for tomorrow.
* Participate in morning briefing with full knowledge of the day's target and plan of action.

**C. Field Activity \& Market Coverage**

* Execute daily field beat plan — minimum number of customer visits and prospect contacts as set by BM.
* Cover assigned micro\-market zones systematically — no repeated coverage of same area while leaving other zones unvisited.
* Attend local events, mandis, weekly markets, and business associations to represent KGF and generate walk\-in traffic.
* Identify new business hubs, growth corridors, and underserved pockets within the catchment; report to BM for territory planning.
* Distribute KGF marketing material — brochures, rate cards, scheme flyers — during field visits and community outreach.
* Maintain a field visit log — customer name, location, purpose, outcome, and follow\-up date — submitted daily to BM.

**D. Customer Relationship Management**

* Build strong, trust\-based relationships with existing customers — visit personally at loan renewal and overdue milestones.
* Educate customers on KGF gold loan products, interest rates, schemes, and repayment options — accurate information only.
* Handle customer queries and concerns in the field; escalate unresolved issues to BM without delay.
* Maintain customer contact details updated in the system — phone number, address, and alternate contact verified at every interaction.
* Support ABM in collecting overdue amounts from field customers — soft follow\-up visits and negotiated repayment commitments.
* Ensure every customer leaves with a positive KGF experience — conduct, language, and professionalism at all times.

**E. Collections Support**

* Assist ABM in overdue recovery — visit 30\-day and 60\-day bucket customers in the field for soft collection follow\-up.
* Communicate repayment reminders to customers approaching due dates — calls and field visits as directed by ABM.
* Collect overdue amounts from field customers where authorised by BM; deposit collected cash to branch cashier same day without exception.
* Never retain any collected cash overnight — any deviation treated as a serious compliance breach.
* Report field customer feedback on repayment difficulty or gold valuation concerns to ABM for resolution.

**F. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Assist customers in completing KYC documentation at the field stage — check completeness before bringing to branch.
* Never promise interest rates, LTV ratios, or loan amounts not sanctioned by KGF credit policy — refer to published scheme cards.
* Comply with KGF code of conduct during all field visits — no soliciting of gifts, commissions, or personal favours from customers.
* Report any competitor activity, fraudulent gold pledging attempts, or suspicious customer behaviour to BM immediately.
* Maintain accurate and honest reporting of field activity — fabricated visit logs treated as gross misconduct.

**G. Reporting \& MIS**

* Submit end\-of\-day field activity report to BM — visits completed, leads generated, disbursements supported, next\-day plan.
* Maintain personal lead tracker — source, contact details, loan requirement, status, and follow\-up schedule.
* Attend weekly performance review with BM — present lead pipeline, conversion status, and reasons for gaps.
* Contribute to branch monthly business plan — provide bottom\-up lead and disbursement forecast for SO territory.

**ELIGIBILITY \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate in any discipline — B.Com / BBA preferred; HSC with strong field experience also considered.
* 1–4 years of field sales experience in NBFC, gold loan, microfinance, insurance, or banking sector.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, local market knowledge, and self\-motivation considered for trainee roles.
* Working knowledge of gold loan products, interest calculation, and KYC norms preferred.
* Strong Tamil communication — ability to converse confidently with diverse customer profiles in the local market.
* Two\-wheeler licence and own vehicle mandatory — daily field coverage across branch catchment required.
* Mobile proficiency — lead tracking app, WhatsApp business communication, and basic MIS reporting.

**KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES**

* Field sales and prospecting **Customer acquisition and lead conversion**
* Local market and community knowledge **Persuasion and objection handling**
* Gold loan product knowledge **Relationship building and retention**
* Time management and beat planning **Reporting discipline and data accuracy**

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* **Monthly disbursement target —** % of individual target achieved — primary performance metric.
* **New customer acquisition —** number of first\-time borrowers onboarded per month.
* **Lead conversion rate —** % of generated leads converted to disbursed loans.
* **Renewal conversion —** % of due\-for\-renewal accounts converted before loan expiry.
* **Referral generation —** number of active referrals collected and converted per month.
* **Field visit compliance —** daily beat plan completion — visits logged vs target.
* **Collections support —** % of assigned overdue accounts contacted and followed up in the month.
* **Documentation accuracy —** % of customer files brought to branch with complete KYC — zero rejection rate at counter.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

* Salary: As per company norms — commensurate with experience and market.
* Performance incentive: Monthly payout linked to disbursement achievement and new customer acquisition — uncapped for top performers.
* Field allowance: Travel reimbursement as per KGF field staff policy.
* EPF \& ESI: As per statutory norms.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_function: Product Management, Production, and Business Development
description:
**About Company:** 




 Our Client is building the Intent Layer for AI\-driven software: the layer that makes sure what a business actually intends is what its AI\-built software ships. Our enterprise product is live in early access. We are founder\-led, customer\-focused, and building something genuinely new in one of the most exciting corners of AI.
 



  





 You would work directly with our founder, who spent 25 years building AI and product at Google and Adobe. For an early\-career PM, that is a rare apprenticeship. You learn product craft from someone who has done it at the highest level, on a real, live product.
 



  





**About Role:** 




 This is a hands\-on Product Manager role, working shoulder to shoulder with the founder. Your job is to take the product from idea to shipped: turn direction into clear specs, keep the modules and projects moving, coordinate with engineering, and close the loop with what customers actually need.
 



  





 A defining part of this role is leverage through AI. We build with cutting\-edge AI tools, and you will learn to use them, Claude and others, to do the work of a much larger team: drafting specs, shaping designs, analyzing feedback, and moving faster than a traditional PM ever could. If the idea of amplifying yourself several times over with AI excites you, you will thrive here.
 



  





 We are clear about the stage. This is an early, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves role with real ownership and real mentorship, not a big\-company seat where you own one slice of a slide. You will touch the whole product.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





 \- Turn direction into execution:\*\* write clear specs and PRDs, break work into projects, and keep everything moving to done.
 



 \- Drive the modules and projects:\*\* own day\-to\-day coordination across the product, track progress, and unblock.
 



 \- Amplify with AI:\*\* use Claude and other AI tools to draft, design, analyze, and ship faster, and become the person who gets the most out of them.
 



 \- Shape the design:\*\* use Claude Design and Figma to turn product needs into wireframes and flows the team can build from.
 



 \- Work with engineering:\*\* translate product intent into something the team can build, and keep the build aligned to it.
 



 \-Stay close to customers:\*\* turn pilot feedback into clear product improvements.
 



 \- Bring order:\*\* documentation, priorities, and follow\-through, so the founder can focus on the hardest calls.
 



  





**What you'll bring** 




 \- 1\-2 years in a product role\*\*, ideally touching B2B or enterprise software.
 



 \- Strong communication and organization:\*\* you write clearly, structure ambiguity, and follow through.
 



 \- Fluency, or fast fluency, with AI tools:\*\* you already use tools like Claude to work smarter, or you will pick them up fast and run. This is central to the role.
 



 \- Design fluency: a good eye for product design and usability, and comfort turning ideas into wireframes and flows with tools like Claude Design and Figma. You do not need to be a visual designer, but you should be able to shape and iterate on design.
 



 \- Analytical skills: you use data to inform decisions, dig into user feedback and product metrics, and structure ambiguous problems with evidence rather than opinion.
 



 \- Product instinct: you think about the user and the "why," not just the task.
 



 \- A builder's temperament: comfortable with ambiguity, hungry to learn, and happy owning a problem end to end without a fully specified ticket.
 



 \- A degree in any field. A B\-school background is a plus, not a requirement.
 



  





**Nice to have** 




  





 \- Exposure to B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
 



 \- Enough technical literacy to talk to engineers.
 



 \- Early\-stage or startup experience.
 



  





**Why join us** 




  





 \- Learn from a founder who has built at the top.\*\* 25 years of product at Google and Adobe, mentoring you directly. Most early\-career PMs wait years for that kind of access.
 



 \- Real ownership, real scope.\*\* You will shape the whole product, not one corner of it, and watch your work ship.
 



 \- Become AI\-native.\*\* You will build what is fast becoming the most valuable skill in the field: getting several times the output from AI tools.
 



 \- Grounded, not hype\-driven.\*\* We are customer\-focused and build deliberately, at a sustainable pace. We hire carefully and invest in the people we bring on for the long run.
 



 \- You will grow fast.\*\* A year here, with this scope and this mentorship, is worth several elsewhere.

 Yes, it is a big deal.  You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. description:
**Description**
 Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.
   

  

 Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.
   

  

 We are seeking a Business Analyst to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high\-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be responsible to be the single source of truth in terms of data and analysis during and after incidents, and ensure metrics at leadership level is reported accurately.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Real\-Time Incident Analytics — Serve as the single source of truth for data and analysis during high\-severity incidents, providing actionable insights to guide response decisions and minimize customer impact.
* Post\-Incident Reporting \& Metrics — Deliver accurate, leadership\-level metrics and post\-incident analysis, ensuring root causes, impact scope, and resolution timelines are clearly documented.
* Cross\-Functional Data Coordination — Partner with dozens of response teams during incidents to aggregate, validate, and synthesize data from multiple systems, enabling a unified operational picture.
* Trend Identification \& Proactive Insights — Analyze incident patterns, contact volume spikes, and service disruption data to identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures that reduce future customer impact.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL or ETL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Tableau
* Experience using very large datasets

**About ValGenesis**
 ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
   

  

 Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

**🚀 We're Hiring Engineers Across All Levels! 🚀**
 Are you ready to build the future with us? At
 **ValGenesis** 
 , we're scaling rapidly and expanding our engineering teams across multiple functions. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we have exciting opportunities for you to grow, innovate, and make an impact.
   

  

**Location:**
 Our Offices are in the following locations:
   

  

 Chennai: Taramani, Chennai
   

  

 Bengaluru: Bengaluru, Karnataka
   

  

 Hyderabad: Ranga Reddy, Telangana
   

  

 🔧 What We’re Hiring For 🔧:
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers with
 **2 to 12 years of experience** 
 across a variety of disciplines, including but not limited to:
   

  

**Software Engineering** 
 (Frontend, Backend, Full Stack)
   

  

**DevOps \& Infrastructure**
**Data Engineering \& Analytics**
**Machine Learning \& AI**
**Quality Assurance \& Automation**
**Embedded Systems \& Hardware**
**Product \& Platform Engineering**
 🌟 What You’ll Do 🌟:
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and scale cutting\-edge solutions.
   

  

 Solve complex technical challenges with creativity and efficiency.
   

  

 Contribute to a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 🎯 What We’re Looking For🎯 :
   

  

 Proven experience in engineering roles (2–12 years).
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for technology.
   

  

 Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 Experience with modern tools, frameworks, and methodologies relevant to your domain.
   

  

**Ready to take the next step?**
 Apply now. Let’s build something amazing together.
   

  

**We’re on a Mission**
 In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance\-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
   

  

 Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end\-to\-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose\-built systems with world\-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
   

  

**The Team You’ll Join**
 Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
   

  

 We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
   

  

 We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
   

  

 We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Python Career Mentor / Webinar Trainer
description:
**Job Type:** Part\-Time / Freelance  
**Mode:** Remote

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced **Python Career Mentor / Webinar Trainer** to conduct online career guidance webinars for students, freshers, and aspiring Python developers.

The role is focused on helping students understand the **Python career roadmap, current industry expectations, career opportunities, required skills, and the journey from learning Python to becoming job\-ready.**

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct engaging and interactive **Python Career Guidance Webinars**.
* Explain the complete **Python career roadmap** from beginner to job\-ready professional.
* Guide students on different career paths, including Python Development, Backend Development, Full Stack Development, Data Analytics, Data Science, Automation, AI, and Machine Learning.
* Explain the skills, frameworks, databases, tools, and technologies required for different Python career paths.
* Help students understand **what companies expect from freshers and entry\-level Python developers**.
* Guide students on practical projects, internships, GitHub, resume building, LinkedIn profile development, interview preparation, and job search strategies.
* Share practical industry insights and real\-world career examples.
* Conduct live Q\&A sessions and address students' career and technical questions.
* Make sessions practical, engaging, and easy to understand for students from different skill levels.

Candidate Requirements

* Strong knowledge of **Python and related career opportunities**.
* Practical experience in Python development, technical training, mentoring, or career guidance.
* Good understanding of current industry requirements for Python\-related roles.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and career paths clearly to students and freshers.
* Comfortable conducting online webinars for groups of students.
* Previous experience conducting webinars, workshops, training sessions, or career guidance sessions is preferred.

Preferred Experience

**2\+ years** of experience in Python development, technical training, mentoring, or related industry roles is preferred.

Engagement

This is a **Part\-Time / Freelance opportunity** for scheduled online webinars. The frequency of sessions may vary based on the webinar schedule.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume and include:

* Python/industry experience
* Training, mentoring, or webinar experience
* Current role
* Availability for online sessions
* Expected fee per webinar/session

Pay: ₹500\.00 \- ₹1,500\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

title: Engineer - 5G / C-V2X Engineer – Embedded Linux
description:
**Job Title: 5G / C\-V2X Engineer – Embedded Linux** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science or related field
 



  





**About Accolade Electronics** 




 Accolade Electronics Pvt. Ltd. is an innovative automotive electronics company specializing in Connected Vehicle, Telematics, eCockpit, Body Control Module (BCM), and embedded mobility solutions. We are looking for passionate engineers to build next\-generation connected vehicle technologies.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **5G / C\-V2X Engineer – Embedded Linux** 
 to develop and integrate Cellular Vehicle\-to\-Everything (C\-V2X) solutions on Linux\-based Telematics Control Units (TCUs). The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded Linux, networking protocols, Linux kernel development, and automotive connectivity technologies.
 



 This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge connected vehicle technologies, 5G communication, and intelligent transportation systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and optimize Embedded Linux software for Telematics Control Units (TCUs).
* Develop and integrate C\-V2X (LTE/5G NR) communication solutions.
* Customize Linux Kernel, Bootloader, and Board Support Packages (BSP).
* Develop and maintain Linux device drivers for PCIe, USB, UART, SPI, CAN, and Ethernet interfaces.
* Implement and optimize networking protocols including TCP/IP, UDP, IPv6, Socket Programming, and Netlink.
* Develop and debug V2X communication protocols based on:
* SAE J2735
* ETSI ITS (CAM, DENM)
* ASN.1 PER Encoding/Decoding
* Implement secure communication using:
* IEEE 1609\.2
* TLS
* IPsec
* V2X PKI
* Support compliance with automotive standards including AIS\-140, AIS\-186, and ETSI ITS.
* Optimize system performance, memory usage, and networking latency.
* Work closely with Hardware, Validation, Product Management, and Manufacturing teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software integration and field issues.



  





**Required Skills** 




 Embedded Software
 


* Embedded C/C\+\+
* Embedded Linux
* Linux Kernel Development
* Device Driver Development
* Yocto Project
* Buildroot
* RTOS



 Networking
 


* TCP/IP
* UDP
* IPv6
* Socket Programming
* Netlink
* QoS
* Network Performance Optimization



 V2X Technologies
 


* LTE C\-V2X
* 5G NR
* SAE J2735
* ETSI ITS
* CAM
* DENM
* ASN.1 PER



 Security
 


* IEEE 1609\.2
* TLS
* IPsec
* PKI



 Embedded Hardware
 



 Experience with one or more of:
 


* STM32
* NXP Processors
* ESP32
* Raspberry Pi
* NVIDIA Jetson



 Hardware Interfaces
 


* UART
* SPI
* I2C
* CAN
* USB
* Ethernet



 IoT Technologies
 


* MQTT
* BLE
* Wi\-Fi
* Cellular Communication
* LoRa



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working on Automotive Telematics or Connected Vehicle products.
