title: Country HR Manager India
description:
Contract Type
   

  

 Permanent
   

  

 Country
   

  

 INDIA
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Pune
   

  

 Your opportunity
   

  

 Lead Country HR for India as the local HR partner and employee\-facing HR leader, ensuring that global HR strategies are translated into compliant, relevant and effective country actions. The role partners with business leaders, managers, HRBPs, COEs and HR Operations Services to strengthen employee engagement, local talent and performance management, employee relations, culture, compliance and organizational effectiveness across India. Act as the connector between local business needs and Sidel’s HR model, ensuring that HR programs, policies and processes are implemented with the right balance of global consistency and local adaptation. Provide advice and coaching to managers and employees, while ensuring smooth collaboration with HR Operations Services on transactional processes such as talent acquisition, onboarding, payroll, data and employee lifecycle administration. Own local employee relations and industrial relations matters where applicable, including grievance, disciplinary, legal and compliance cases, ensuring timely, fair and compliant resolution in line with Sidel policies and Indian labour regulations. In line with Group policies, the HR operating model and local labour law, the Country HR Manager is responsible for country\-specific HR delivery and advisory activities for India, while coordinating closely with regional HR, HRBPs, COEs and HR Operations Services to ensure seamless employee and manager experience.
   

  

 Your Mission
   

  

* YOUR MISSION


 Country HR leadership: Act as the primary HR point of contact for India, representing HR locally and ensuring managers and employees receive clear, consistent and timely HR support.
   

  

 Business partnering: Advise and coach managers on people topics, workforce planning, organization effectiveness, performance, engagement, retention and change management.
   

  

 Employee relations and compliance: Manage employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, sensitive cases and statutory requirements in line with local labour law and Sidel governance.
   

  

 Local policies and governance: Maintain country policies, procedures and employee communications, ensuring they remain current, compliant and aligned with Group guidance.
   

  

 Talent and performance: Drive local implementation of talent, performance, succession, development and engagement processes; coach managers to ensure quality conversations and follow\-through on actions.
   

  

 Talent acquisition collaboration: Partner with hiring managers, TA Operations, HRBPs and COEs through requisition, selection, offer and onboarding stages, with Country HR leading local package alignment, candidate experience and stakeholder management where required.
   

  

 Employee engagement and culture: Anchor local culture, employee listening, engagement actions and employer value proposition initiatives; strengthen Sidel’s local employer brand in India.
   

  

 HR Operations interface: Work with HR Operations Services to ensure efficient delivery of payroll, onboarding, exits, mobility, HR data, documentation and other employee lifecycle processes.
   

  

 Data and insights: Use HR data, dashboards and workforce insights to support decision\-making, identify people risks, track process quality and advise managers with facts and trends.
   

  

 Manager capability: Support people managers through guidance, training and practical tools on core people processes, performance management, engagement, employee relations and change leadership.
   

  

 Health, safety and wellbeing: Promote a safe, respectful and inclusive work environment, partnering with local leaders and HSE as needed.
   

  

 Industrial relations: Manage union or works council interactions where applicable and maintain a constructive labour relations environment.
   

  

 Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, harmonize and improve HR processes, contributing to digital adoption, data quality, automation and consistent employee experience.
   

  

 Your Profile
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or related discipline is preferred.
   

  

 HR certification or formal training in labour law, employee relations, HR business partnering, coaching or change management is a plus.
   

  

 Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in international, manufacturing, capital equipment, engineering, industrial or service environments.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, statutory requirements, employee relations practices and local HR governance.
   

  

 Proven HR business partnering experience, with ability to coach managers, influence stakeholders and translate business needs into practical people actions.
   

  

 Experience managing employee relations, performance, talent, engagement, organizational change and local policy implementation.
   

  

 Ability to collaborate effectively with HR Operations Services, HRBPs, COEs and regional HR teams in a matrix organization.
   

  

 Data\-driven mindset with comfort using HR systems, dashboards and insights to support decisions and improve process quality.
   

  

 Strong communication, consulting, problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills; able to balance empathy, compliance and business impact.
   

  

 Multicultural mindset and ability to work effectively with local, regional and global teams.
   

  

 Fluent in English; local language capability relevant to India is an advantage.

title: Regional Human Resources Manager
description:
Compensation will be paid in local currency (INR)
 



**Position Summary** 




 The Regional HR Manager – India \& Asia serves as the primary Human Resources business partner and operational HR leader for employees across India, China, Southeast Asia, and other Asia\-Pacific locations (including Australia as business needs evolve). As the sole HR professional supporting the region, this individual is responsible for delivering the full employee lifecycle while ensuring compliance with local employment laws and company policies across multiple countries.
 



 This is a highly hands\-on, individual contributor role requiring a proactive, service\-oriented HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, global environment. The successful candidate is equally comfortable developing HR solutions, executing day\-to\-day HR activities, and partnering with business leaders to deliver an exceptional employee experience.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as the primary HR contact for all employees and managers throughout the India and Asia region.
* Manage the full employee lifecycle, including recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, development, transfers, promotions, and offboarding.
* Lead recruitment efforts for the region, partnering with hiring managers to identify, attract, and hire top talent.
* Deliver a positive and consistent onboarding experience for all new hires.
* Provide timely coaching and guidance to managers on employee relations, performance management, organizational changes, and employment practices.
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, regulations, and statutory requirements across multiple countries within the region, partnering with legal counsel and external providers as needed.
* Coordinate with payroll, benefits, and external vendors to ensure accurate and compliant HR administration.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR data within Workday and other HR systems.
* Support compensation, benefits, and annual HR processes, including performance reviews, merit planning, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Partner with global HR colleagues to implement corporate programs while adapting them appropriately for local requirements.
* Develop trusted relationships with employees and leaders by providing responsive, practical, and customer\-focused HR support.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and drive operational excellence across the region.
* Participate in global HR projects, acquisitions, integrations, and organizational initiatives as assigned.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of progressive Human Resources experience supporting multiple countries across Asia.
* Demonstrated experience supporting India along with other Asia\-Pacific countries such as China, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, South Korea, or Australia.
* Strong working knowledge of employment laws and HR practices across multiple Asia\-Pacific jurisdictions.
* Experience independently managing the full employee lifecycle.
* Strong recruiting experience across technical, manufacturing, engineering, and professional positions preferred.
* Experience supporting a multinational organization with geographically dispersed employees.
* HRIS experience, preferably Workday.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet deadlines.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with global teams.
* Demonstrated discretion in handling confidential employee information.



**Success Profile**

* A hands\-on HR professional who enjoys executing as much as advising.
* Comfortable serving as the sole HR representative for a diverse, multi\-country region.
* Knowledgeable about the cultural and legal differences across Asia and able to adapt HR practices accordingly.
* Highly organized, responsive, and able to manage competing priorities without sacrificing quality.
* Flexible with work schedules to support employees, leaders, and global HR partners across multiple time zones.
* Customer\-focused with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Able to build trust quickly while maintaining confidentiality and exercising sound judgment.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Recruiting Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone of Postman's recruiting function. In this role, you will ensure that every search runs smoothly from open to close — keeping interviews scheduled, data clean, feedback flowing, and candidates well\-informed throughout their experience. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is organized, detail\-oriented, and excited to build foundational expertise in talent acquisition at a fast\-growing technology company. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and will play a direct role in how Postman is perceived as an employer.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
*Interview Coordination*
* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling across all active roles, coordinating availability between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers with a high degree of accuracy and responsiveness
* Send timely confirmations, reminders, and logistical details to all interview participants
* Manage reschedules and last\-minute changes with professionalism and minimal disruption to the process
* Proactively identify and solve scheduling or process bottlenecks, continuously improving recruiting workflows and coordination processes


*Data Integrity \& ATS Hygiene*
* Audit active job requisitions to ensure all required fields are complete and accurate in the ATS — including job details, compensation bands, stage statuses, and interviewer assignments
* Flag and resolve data gaps in collaboration with recruiters before they affect reporting
* Ensure every closed role has a complete and accurate record before it is archived


*Feedback \& Interview Completion*
* Monitor interview completion rates and follow up with interviewers to ensure feedback is submitted within expected SLAs
* Track which interviews have been recorded and flag any gaps to the relevant recruiter
* Maintain a real\-time view of where feedback is outstanding across all active searches


*Candidate Experience \& Surveys*
* Deliver a high\-touch, candidate\-first experience across every stage of the interview process
* Coordinate the distribution of candidate experience surveys at key touchpoints in the process
* Track response rates and flag low engagement to the recruiting team
* Compile survey results on a regular cadence and summarize key themes for review


*Employer Brand Monitoring*
* Monitor Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Blind, and other relevant platforms for new candidate and employee reviews related to the recruiting and interview experience
* Surface notable feedback to the recruiting team on a regular basis
* Help maintain the accuracy of Postman's employer profiles across platforms


*Metrics \& Reporting*
* Collect and organize data on completed roles, including time to fill, source, offer acceptance, and interview\-to\-offer ratios
* Prepare regular metric summaries for the Head of Recruiting
* Support the team in ensuring data is ready and accurate for monthly and quarterly reporting cycles


**About You**
 You are someone who takes genuine pride in keeping things running well. You notice when something is missing before anyone else does, and you follow through without needing to be reminded. You are comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously and can shift priorities calmly when something urgent comes up.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; coursework or internship experience in HR, business, communications, or operations is a plus but not required
* 2\-4 years of professional experience; strong internship or project\-based experience is equally valued
* Exceptional attention to detail — you catch the things others miss
* Strong written communication skills; you can write a clear, professional message to a candidate or a senior hiring manager with equal ease
* Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and calendar management; experience with an ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) is a bonus
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style — you understand that your work makes everyone around you more effective
* Curiosity about how recruiting works as a function and interest in growing within talent acquisition or HR operations over time
* Thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment while managing multiple priorities with strong ownership and attention to detail


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get To Know Our Team:**
 The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are looking for someone to lead our Global Employee Relations Team as a Senior Manager, Employee Relations. This role leads the development of policies, advisory standards, case governance and analytics to ensure fair, consistent and legally sound people practices. The incumbent partners closely with HR leadership, Legal, unions, and government agencies to manage complex disciplinary matters, labor relations issues and emerging workforce risks.
   

  

 The role combines deep industrial relationships expertise, policy leadership, stakeholder influence, and data\-driven decision making, and serves as a subject\-matter authority on employment legislation and industrial relations strategy.
   

  

 Our Employee Relations consultants work closely with key stakeholders including our Legal/Compliance team, Corporate Tax, Corporate Governance, Talent Business Partner team and the Senior Management Team to support employees in challenging circumstances, and we seek to identify trends and share insights to adjust our people management practices to get the best talent outcomes. We advise and enable managers to make the best possible decisions, challenging practices that go beyond legal obligation to protect our unique culture at Agoda.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Elevate Compliance and Policy Expertise: Act as the go\-to specialist on ER Matters, guiding managers in adhering to company policies, local laws, and regulations. Establish governance standards, operating guidelines and decision frameworks to ensure consistency across the organization. Translate employment legislation, case law and regulatory changes into clear institutional policies and guidance.
* Enhance Manager Effectiveness: Lead the design, review and implementation and advise people managers on the Organization\-wide employee \& labor relations and HR policy framework. Critically evaluate systemic issues in manager capability and practices and escalate them appropriately to business leaders for sustainable resolution.
* Union Engagement: Represent the organization in union consultations, negotiations, arbitration and dispute resolution forums. Analyze union and management proposals to assess policy, financial and employee\-relations implications. Support collective bargaining strategies through data, benchmarking and scenario analysis.
* Streamline Disciplinary and Termination Processes: Ensure accurate execution and documentation of disciplinary actions and terminations to minimize labor disputes.
* Lead Investigations and Employee Relations processes: Conduct impartial investigations into grievances and serve as a dedicated Employee Relations partner, identifying trends and insights to inform procedural improvements.
* Drive Performance and Policy Enhancements through Analytics: Analyze performance management data and past misconduct cases to develop recommendations for capability\-building, policy revisions, training enhancements, and more effective management practices.
* Optimize Performance Management and Offboarding: Spearhead improvements in performance management systems and refine offboarding processes, incorporating data from different sources to enhance employee experiences.
* Regulatory \& Dispute Management: Liaise with Legal team to represent and manage the Company in negotiations, arbitrations and dispute resolution forums or other regulatory authorities.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Deep understanding of employee relations, labor relations and workplace dispute management.
* Strong working knowledge of employment legislation, regulations and industrial relations practices.
* Ability to interpret legislation and apply it practically within complex organizational environments.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior leaders, unions and regulators.
* Strong negotiation, mediation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to balance organizational risk with empathy and sound judgement.
* Degree in Human Resource Management, Law, Industrial Relations, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of 13 years in Employee and Labor Relations or HR Business Partnering roles within large or regulated organizations, with a proven track record of handling complex employee relations issues.
* Extensive knowledge of employment laws and regulations in the relevant region, with the ability to interpret and apply them in various scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience managing and executing restructuring/change management projects
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
* Ability to cope well with ambiguity and change
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethical standards in handling sensitive information and situations.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make well\-informed decisions, balancing legal compliance with business needs.
* Proficiency in using data and analytics to inform decision\-making processes and improve employee relations strategies.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong communication skills to effectively convey complex information.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities and a desire to take on managerial responsibilities in the future.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Curiosity, ready to challenge current practices and perspectives
* Great attention to detail
* Great sense of ownership and reliability
* Multicultural or International Experience
* Humility, flexibility, good interpersonal skills

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator, Hiring Events
description:
**About the Team**
 We're building the future of DoorDash India, and that starts with the teams who hire it. Our India Talent Acquisition team partners closely with business leaders to build high\-performing, candidate\-first hiring experiences at scale. This role sits in the center of that motion, supporting high\-volume Customer Support hiring through coordinated, well\-run hiring events and strong recruitment operations.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Talent Acquisition Coordinator to own the logistics behind large\-scale hiring events for Customer Support roles in India. You'll partner with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and operations stakeholders to keep candidate flow moving, deliver a strong candidate experience, and make sure every hiring event runs smoothly. Over time, this role can expand into university, apprenticeship, and employer\-brand activation as our hiring model evolves.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Own end\-to\-end coordination for on\-site and virtual hiring events, including scheduling, venue logistics, candidate communications, and day\-of support.
* Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to keep high\-volume Customer Support pipelines moving quickly and accurately.
* Coordinate candidate interview schedules, assessment centers, confirmations, and follow\-ups.
* Track candidates and hiring activity in the ATS, keeping records clean, current, and usable.
* Support reporting on hiring progress, event outcomes, candidate experience, and process bottlenecks.
* Work cross\-functionally with TA, HR Operations, and business stakeholders to remove friction from the hiring process.
* Help improve recruiting workflows, templates, and candidate communications as volume and complexity grow.
* Support future hiring activations such as university events, apprenticeship campaigns, and brand\-led talent outreach as the role broadens.


**We're excited about you because you have…**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, HR operations, event coordination, or a fast\-paced administrative role.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Confidence managing lots of moving pieces without losing the human side of the candidate experience.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Comfort working with scheduling tools, spreadsheets, ATS systems, and shared calendars.
* A bias for action, strong judgment, and the ability to stay calm when plans change.
* Interest in high\-volume hiring, candidate experience, and building repeatable processes.
* A collaborative style and comfort working across teams and reporting lines in a matrixed environment.


**Nice to have**
* Experience supporting high\-volume hiring, customer support hiring, or contact center hiring.
* Exposure to campus, apprenticeship, or early\-career programs.
* Experience with on\-site interview days, assessment centers, or hiring events.
* Familiarity with employer branding, talent marketing, or recruitment campaigns.


**What success looks like**
* Hiring events run smoothly and on time.
* Candidates get clear, timely communication.
* Recruiters spend less time on logistics and more time on hiring decisions.
* Event\-to\-offer and event\-to\-join data is visible and actionable.
* The role becomes a reliable operational engine for India TA.


**About DoorDash**
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
   

  

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: HR Executive - Talent Management & Organization Development
description:
**Role Summary:** 




 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR professional to support key initiatives across Talent Management, Learning \& Development, Employee Engagement, and Organizational Development. The role offers an excellent opportunity to work on strategic HR initiatives that strengthen employee experience, build organizational capability, and drive a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Talent Management \& Succession Planning** 



* Support the execution of talent identification, assessment, and succession planning processes.
* Coordinate talent review discussions and maintain talent\-related documentation and dashboards.
* Assist in implementing talent development initiatives and tracking progress.



**Employee Engagement** 



* Plan and execute employee engagement programs and culture\-building initiatives.
* Monitor employee feedback through surveys and connect forums, analyze insights, and support action planning.
* Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving employee experience, retention, and organizational culture.



**Learning \& Development** 



* Coordinate end\-to\-end learning and development programs across functions.
* Ensure timely nominations, participation, and completion of training programs.
* Track training effectiveness, maintain learning records, and identify capability\-building opportunities.



**Rewards \& Recognition** 



* Drive Rewards \& Recognition initiatives such as GEMS, Kudos, and other recognition platforms.
* Ensure timely execution of recognition programs and promote a culture of appreciation.
* Track program effectiveness and recommend improvements to enhance employee participation.



**HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards and MIS reports.
* Analyze data related to attrition, engagement, learning, and talent metrics.
* Generate actionable insights to support business and HR decision\-making.



**Process Excellence** 



* Support HR process improvement initiatives through data analysis, process mapping, and gap identification.
* Recommend and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.



**GPTW (Great Place to Work) Initiatives** 



* Coordinate and drive Great Place to Work (GPTW) projects and engagement activities.
* Support survey planning, communication, action tracking, and implementation of improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to strengthen workplace culture and employer branding.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




**Educational Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resources (HR) is preferred.



**Experience** 



* 0–2 years of experience in Human Resources, preferably in Organization Development (OD), Talent Management, Learning \& Development, or Employee Engagement.



**Functional \& Technical Skills** 



* Basic proficiency in MS Excel and HR analytics.
* Understanding of Talent Management, Learning \& Development, and Employee Engagement practices.
* Strong coordination, planning, and execution skills.
* Ability to interpret HR data and generate meaningful insights.



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong execution, ownership, and follow\-through.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams.
* Proactive approach and willingness to take initiative.
* Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong business acumen with a solution\-oriented mindset.
* High attention to detail and organizational skills.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

 The Offshore QA Analyst is to serve US Client in
 **US timings** 
 and will be responsible for supporting the quality assurance process by understanding requirements, creating and executing test cases, logging defects, performing retesting, and supporting functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing activities. * Support release testing and production validation activities as required.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Good understanding of QA methodologies and software testing lifecycle.
* Experience working in Agile projects.
* Hands\-on experience in test case design, execution, defect logging, and retesting.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar test management tools.
* Basic understanding of functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into test scenarios.
* Good communication skills, especially when working with onshore teams.
* Ability to work independently and provide clear daily status updates.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Tosca, UiPath, or similar tools is a plus.
* Experience in large enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP, or S/4HANA is a plus.



**Qualifications** 



* **1–4** 
 years of QA/testing experience. Experience working as part of an offshore delivery team.
* Experience coordinating with onshore QA leads, developers, and business users.
* Exposure to test automation execution or basic automation scripting.
* Experience in data validation, integration testing, and end\-to\-end business process testing.

 The Offshore QA Analyst will report to the QA Lead or Project Manager and will work closely with onshore and offshore team members to ensure timely and quality delivery.

title: Associate Software Test Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Summary**
 Job Description
   

  

 As an Associate Software Test Engineer, you will meaningfully contribute to the software development team on all stages of the software development lifecycle, including test design, test automation, and testing activities for industry\-leading commercial software known for its innovation and usability, in particular real\-time scalable features based on Rockwell's Manufacturing Execution System (MES) that are often integrated with machine automation and control systems and ERP software.
   

  

 You will be responsible for active participation in requirements development, coding, and verification of automated test systems in all stages of the software development lifecycle
   

  

 You must collaborate with multiple global teams and require you to work in the large project teams.
   

  

 Joining Rockwell Automation Software Development group allows you to become part of a team that is committed to using reliable and well\-thought\-out engineering and software development practices such as SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).
   

  

 You will report to the Team Lead, Software Engineering and have a hybrid schedule working in Hinjewadi, Pune, India
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Design, maintain tests
* Develop automated tests, monitor the results, and report software defects
* Develop test documentation required by software development process
* Provide work estimates and status report. Maintain interaction to ensure assigned tasks are completed.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
* 1 year of experience in test automation for new products or software systems.


**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have**
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented designs in Java.
* Experience with test automation and scripting languages (preferred Marathon or Selenium)
* Knowledge of multiple design patterns for enterprise applications
* Knowledge in test management tools (e.g., qTest)
* Familiarity with common development tools as Eclipse, SVN, GitLab, JUnit, JIRA, Jenkins, ANT and Maven
* Understanding of modern software delivery practices like rapid prototyping, CI/CD, containerization, virtualization etc. and multiple test strategies like TDD / BDD.
* Experience working in SAFe methodology.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes …
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:

What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. * System Administration experience (small system or personal networks is great).
* Understanding of manual and/or automated testing best practices.

* Knowledge of automation tool building and test automation frameworks.

* 2–3 years of experience in Manual \& Automation Testing for Android and iOS applications.

title: Sr Performance Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Senior Performance Test Engineer
   

  

 Johnson Controls is committed to creating intelligent, healthy, and sustainable buildings that help customers improve outcomes across safety, comfort, efficiency, and reliability. We are looking for a Senior Performance Test Engineer who can help ensure our digital experiences and connected solutions perform consistently under real\-world demand.
   

  

 In this role, you will work across QA and engineering teams to shape performance testing strategy, strengthen automation, and uncover opportunities to improve system behavior before issues reach customers.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As a Senior Performance Test Engineer, you will design, execute, and evolve performance testing for web applications, databases, and APIs. You will combine hands\-on scripting with analytical thinking to identify bottlenecks, validate scalability, and support confident releases for high\-impact systems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop performance test scripts using Java\-based tools such as JMeter, BlazeMeter, Gatling, or LoadRunner.
* Plan, execute, and report on performance tests for web applications, databases, and APIs.
* Create and maintain an automated performance testing framework that supports repeatable and scalable execution.
* Collaborate with QA, development, and stakeholders to integrate performance testing into the overall quality strategy.
* Analyze results to identify bottlenecks, tune test scenarios, and propose corrective actions.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and help resolve performance issues in software systems.
* Continuously improve performance testing processes, methods, and reporting to strengthen release readiness.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* Own performance quality from planning through execution and analysis, with clear accountability for results and follow\-through.
* Stay close to the application flow, data path, and user experience so you focus on the issues that matter most.
* Use root\-cause analysis and candid reporting to improve scripts, frameworks, and test coverage after every cycle.
* Partner closely with QA, development, and business stakeholders to remove obstacles and resolve bottlenecks as one team.
* Use Java\-based performance testing tools and well\-controlled test data to keep results reliable and comparable.
* Document assumptions, scenarios, findings, and recommendations so outcomes are easy to review and act on.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\-10 years of experience in QA performance engineering, senior test engineering, or a similar hands\-on testing role.
* Hands\-on experience designing and executing performance tests for web applications, databases, and APIs.
* Practical experience with JMeter, BlazeMeter, Gatling, or LoadRunner.
* Experience creating or maintaining automated performance testing frameworks using Java\-based tools.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend fixes.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with QA, development, and stakeholders.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with cloud environments, preferably Azure, and cloud\-based testing solutions.
* Exposure to large\-scale, customer\-facing applications or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with monitoring, profiling, or observability tools used during performance analysis.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 Join a mission\-led organization where your work contributes to reliable, high\-performing systems that support customers around the world. You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, keep learning, and be part of a collaborative environment that values physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your performance engineering expertise to a team that values quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply.

 with

 to help build, automate, and scale our cloud infrastructure. You will play a critical role in improving deployment reliability, system scalability, infrastructure security, and operational excellence.
 



 You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Security teams to build highly available, secure, and resilient infrastructure capable of supporting millions of customer interactions every day.
 



 If you enjoy solving infrastructure challenges, automating repetitive tasks, and building reliable cloud\-native systems, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CI/CD \& Release Engineering
 


* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Automate application deployment and release processes across development, staging, and production environments.
* Improve deployment reliability while minimizing downtime and manual intervention.
* Implement automated testing and deployment best practices.



 Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering
 


* Build, manage, and optimize scalable infrastructure on AWS (preferred) or other cloud platforms.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Ensure infrastructure is highly available, secure, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-efficient.

 Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and environment setup.

 Monitoring, Reliability \& Incident Management
 


* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or similar tools.
* Monitor infrastructure health and application performance.
* Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.
* Improve system reliability, uptime, and observability.



 Security \& Compliance
 


* Implement infrastructure security best practices, including IAM, VPC security, secrets management, and access control.
* Ensure secure deployment pipelines and infrastructure configurations.
* Work closely with engineering teams to improve platform security and compliance.



 Automation \& Scripting
 


* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, or Shell scripting.
* Build internal tools to simplify deployments, monitoring, infrastructure management, and operational workflows.
* Continuously identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through automation.



 Collaboration
 


* Work closely with Software Engineers to improve deployment workflows and production readiness.
* Support engineering teams in debugging infrastructure\-related issues.
* Participate in architecture discussions and recommend DevOps best practices.
* Contribute to documentation, SOPs, and infrastructure standards.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **2–8 years** 
 of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure.

* Experience with Git (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket).
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS CodePipeline, or GitLab CI.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
* Experience implementing monitoring and logging solutions.
* Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, or Shell.
* Good understanding of Linux system administration and networking fundamentals.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience working with microservices\-based architectures.
* Familiarity with Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or message queues.
* Experience managing MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL infrastructure.
* Knowledge of Nginx, reverse proxies, load balancing, and API gateways.
* Experience with container orchestration and service mesh technologies.
* AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, SysOps Administrator) is a plus.
* Experience working in high\-growth SaaS startups.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Build highly reliable and scalable cloud infrastructure.
* Improve deployment speed and reduce deployment failures.
* Maintain high system uptime and infrastructure availability.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and infrastructure management.
* Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response.
* Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, security, and cost.
* Partner effectively with Engineering to ensure reliable product releases.



  





**Why Join AiSensy?** 



* Build and scale infrastructure powering one of India's fastest\-growing WhatsApp\-first SaaS platforms.
* Solve large\-scale infrastructure and reliability challenges supporting billions of customer interactions.
* Work with modern cloud\-native technologies and automation tools.
* Collaborate with a high\-performing engineering team in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Competitive compensation, ownership, and excellent career growth opportunities.

 Stable, secure, and scalable platform operations.

 Improved database performance, resiliency, and recoverability.

 Improved security compliance and reduced operational risk.

 Better operational efficiency and proactive issue detection.

 Faster defect resolution and improved customer experience.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Sioniq**
 Sioniq is a technology\-driven company focused on delivering reliable, scalable, and innovative IT solutions. We are looking for a skilled Network Engineer to join our team and help design, implement, maintain, and optimize our network infrastructure.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Network Engineer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in managing enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, network security, and troubleshooting, along with the ability to ensure high availability and performance of network systems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.
* Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless networks.
* Monitor network performance and ensure optimal uptime and reliability.
* Troubleshoot network issues and perform root cause analysis.
* Implement network security best practices, including access controls and firewall policies.
* Collaborate with system administrators, cloud teams, and IT support for seamless network operations.
* Perform network upgrades, firmware updates, and infrastructure enhancements.
* Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
* Support disaster recovery planning and business continuity initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and networking standards.


**Required Skills**
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, and VPN technologies.
* Experience with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or similar networking solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with firewall configuration and network security.
* Familiarity with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
* Knowledge of wireless networking technologies.
* Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is an added advantage.
* Understanding of network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, or PowerShell) is a plus.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience as a Network Engineer or in a similar role.
* Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, or equivalent are preferred.


**Preferred Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to participate in on\-call support when required.

title: Head of Technology and Service Operations
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Position Summary**
 The Head of Technology and Service Operations is a senior executive responsible for the global operations, service delivery, and reliability of mission\-critical transit payment systems used by millions of passengers daily. The role leads more than 500 staff across two global 24x7 operations centers (UK and India), localized in\-country teams, and multiple customer contact centers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Reliability \& Availability:**
* Deliver Five Nines Availability (99\.999%): Build and enforce architectural and operational practices that ensure global transit payment systems achieve and sustain ultra\-high uptime. This includes proactive monitoring, high\-availability design enforcement, and automated failover systems across cloud and on\-premises platforms.
* Govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs) \& Error Budgets: Define, track, and report SLOs for all critical services, ensuring error budgets are managed responsibly to balance reliability with change velocity.
* Transaction Performance Management: Guarantee low\-latency, high\-throughput processing across all environments, actively tuning Oracle databases, Kubernetes clusters, UCS fabrics and cloud services for peak demand conditions (e.g., major city events, commuter surges).
* Preventative Maintenance Program: Own a proactive, structured maintenance strategy (firmware updates, DB patching, load balancing, failover readiness) to ensure reliability and reduce risk of unplanned outages.


**Incident, Problem \& Change Management**
* Global Incident Oversight: Lead the 24x7 incident response process across UK and India operations centers, ensuring ≥95% SLA compliance for response and resolution.
* Root Cause \& Blameless Postmortems: Mandate blameless postmortems for every significant incident, driving systemic fixes to prevent recurrence and sharing lessons learned across all regions.
* Problem Management: Establish a structured problem management process to identify trends, reduce repeat incidents, and address root technical or process flaws.
* Change Governance: Oversee change management to balance service stability with innovation. Implement automated pipelines where possible to reduce manual error and ensure changes are tested for resilience before release.
* Recovery Metrics: Continuously track and drive down Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Recover (MTTR) with quarterly improvement goals.


**Observability, Automation \& SRE Practices**
* Full\-Stack Observability: Deploy and govern monitoring solutions across metrics, logs, and traces, enabling real\-time visibility into system health and early anomaly detection.
* Automation of Toil: Drive a culture of automation by eliminating repetitive manual tasks in patching, scaling, failover, and incident response. Track progress with explicit automation coverage targets.
* Chaos Engineering \& Resilience Testing: Institutionalize chaos testing and DR drills (“game days”) to validate RTO/RPO readiness and system recovery under stress conditions.
* Capacity \& Performance Engineering: Oversee predictive capacity planning to ensure the system scales automatically to meet load and maintain performance even under extreme demand conditions.
* Proactive Reliability Improvements: Fund and prioritize engineering initiatives aimed at improving long\-term service resilience, not just reactive firefighting.


**Global Operations \& Customer Support**
* Global Ops Center Leadership: Direct two 24x7 global operations centers (UK and India) as the backbone of global service delivery. Ensure staffing, shift rotations, and runbooks meet the highest standards of responsiveness and reliability.
* Localized Team Oversight: Manage in\-country support teams that ensure local compliance, and customer\-specific responsiveness.
* Customer Contact Centers: Own the operations of customer\-facing contact centers, ensuring tight integration with back\-end service teams to provide consistent, rapid, and high\-quality customer experience.
* Standardization Across Regions: Drive consistency of ITIL\-aligned service management processes globally, ensuring customers experience the same high standards regardless of geography.


**Compliance, Risk \& Audit Readiness**
* Global Compliance Ownership: Ensure operations remain compliant with ISO27001, PCI DSS v4\.1, Essential Eight, Cyber Essentials, GDPR, and all other local privacy regulations in customer jurisdictions.
* Audit Readiness \& Evidence: Maintain continuous audit readiness with robust evidence trails across all systems, processes, and controls, avoiding last\-minute remediation before audits.
* Corporate CISO \& Service Assurance Partnership: Work in lockstep with the Corporate CISO and Service Assurance functions to embed security controls, risk frameworks, and governance processes into day\-to\-day operations, aiming for regulatory compliance excellence.
* Risk Reporting: Provide transparent reporting to the COO and Senior Leadership Teams on compliance posture, vulnerabilities, audit results, and remediation progress.
* Vulnerability Management: Ensure vulnerabilities are tracked, prioritized, and remediated on schedule, with operational accountability for timely fixes.


**Financial Management \& Vendor Oversight**
* Budget Accountability: Own the operations budget, ensuring disciplined financial management, proactive forecasting, and cost optimization across global operations.
* Abatements \& Liquidated Damages: Minimize exposure to penalties by delivering against contractual SLAs, proactively addressing risks that might result in service\-level breaches.
* Vendor \& Partner Management: Oversee the performance of critical vendors and partners — including telcos, cloud providers, and managed service providers. Hold them accountable to contractual SLAs and enforce remedies when necessary.
* Commercial Strategy: Negotiate favorable terms for renewals and expansions, aligning vendor performance with global service reliability goals.
* Cost Optimization: Continuously evaluate opportunities to optimize spending without compromising reliability or compliance.


**Leadership \& Governance**
* Executive Leadership: Act as a key member of the Senior Leadership Team, reporting to the COO, with direct accountability for global technology and service operations.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the CTO and Software Delivery leaders to align infrastructure improvements, operational enhancements, and vulnerability remediation with technology roadmaps.
* Cadence of Accountability: Establish and enforce disciplined operational cadences (daily incident reviews, weekly ops reviews, monthly resilience drills, quarterly DR game days, annual audit cycles).
* Culture of Excellence: Foster a global culture of reliability\-first thinking, preventative maintenance, process rigor, and continuous improvement.
* Talent Leadership: Build and develop global operational leadership talent, ensuring succession planning, skills development, and team engagement across all regions.


**KPIs**
* Service Reliability: Sustain 99\.999% uptime across mission\-critical systems, with consistently low latency and high throughput.
* Incident Outcomes: ≥95% SLA compliance for incident response and resolution; demonstrate quarterly improvement in MTTR/MTTD.
* Preventative Maintenance \& Resilience: 100% completion of scheduled maintenance; successful quarterly DR drills with RTO/RPO close to zero.
* Automation \& Efficiency: Year\-on\-year reduction of manual toil, with measurable increases in automation coverage.
* Compliance Excellence: Zero major findings in ISO27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, Essential Eight, and local regulatory audits; evidence and control logs always audit\-ready.
* Financial Stewardship: Deliver operations budget to plan; minimize abatements/liquidated damages; ≥98% vendor SLA compliance.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive CSAT/NPS with transit authority clients and strong feedback from COO, CISO, CTO, and board stakeholders.


**Candidate Profile**
* Leadership: 15\+ years in global technology operations, with 10\+ years in senior leadership of large\-scale, 24x7 organizations.
* Technical Breadth: Strong working knowledge of Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Oracle databases, UCS fabrics, and enterprise networks; proven track record delivering highly available, resilient platforms.
* Service \& Reliability Engineering: Deep experience with ITIL service management integrated with SRE practices (SLOs, error budgets, observability, automation, chaos testing).
* Compliance \& Risk: Demonstrated success managing ISO27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and local privacy obligations; experienced in working directly with CISOs and Service Assurance functions.
* Financial \& Vendor Management: Proven ability to manage large budgets, minimize penalties, and hold global/cloud/telco vendors accountable to SLAs.
* Leadership Attributes: Process\-driven operator with a reliability\-first mindset; skilled communicator with executive presence; committed to building high\-performing, globally distributed teams.

title: Network Operations Engineer(NOC)
description:
**Role Description**
 We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer with 3\+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise across networking, security, wireless, DDI, cloud networking, and observability platforms, with a strong focus on maintaining a healthy network estate through proactive monitoring, incident management, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Monitor the health, availability, and performance of the enterprise network estate using approved monitoring tools. Identify network s, performance issues, and service\-impacting events, and escalate them to the appropriate engineering teams.
   

  

 Perform initial triage and basic troubleshooting to support faster incident resolution. Assist with collecting logs, diagnostics, and monitoring data required for investigations and root cause analysis.
   

  

 Monitor Palo Alto Firewalls, Cisco Routing \& Switching, Cisco Wireless, Infoblox, and Azure networking environments, highlighting operational concerns.
   

  

 Track network capacity, utilization, availability, and service health through monitoring dashboards. Maintain operational documentation, monitoring procedures, runbooks, and ing standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with Network, Security, Cloud, and Infrastructure teams to support timely incident detection, escalation, and resolution.
   

  

**Required Experience \& Skills**
 Minimum 3 years of experience in Network Engineering, Network Operations, or Infrastructure Support.
   

  

 Strong expertise in network monitoring, event correlation, management, and incident response.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience managing and monitoring a large\-scale enterprise network environment.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with: Palo Alto Firewalls Cisco Routing \& Switching Cisco Wireless Access Points Infoblox (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) Azure Cloud Networking Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as SolarWinds, Datadog, ManageEngine, or equivalent tools.
   

  

 Working knowledge of routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, and cloud networking, with the ability to perform initial troubleshooting, identify issues, and provide timely escalation to engineering teams
   

  

 Understanding of network protocols including OSPF, BGP, VLANs, STP, QoS, NAT, VPN, and network security principles.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 CCNA certification or equivalent networking certification preferred.
   

  

 Exposure to SD\-WAN technologies and network automation is an advantage. Experience working in large enterprise or healthcare environments is desirable.
   

  

 Ideal Candidate A proactive engineer with a strong operational mindset who can effectively monitor the network estate, identify issues before they impact users, and drive rapid resolution of incidents, ensuring secure, stable, and highly available network services that support business and clinical operations
   

  

**Skills**
 Firewall, Datadog, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Issue Analysis, Palo Alto Networks, Production Support, Routing

 As a Junior AI / Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for building the backend services and agent pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable, structured, and safe to use in production. Your work will sit at the foundation of every agent capability we ship.
 



 This is systems engineering around AI models
 



**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* **API Development:** 
 Design and maintain FastAPI services that expose agent capabilities as clean, versioned APIs.
* **Agent Pipelines:** 
 Build LangChain orchestration pipelines with structured I/O contracts, retry logic, and fallback handling.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** 
 Work with Azure infrastructure including Azure OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and Container Apps.
* **Output Reliability:** 
 Implement output validation and schema enforcement layers that make LLM responses trustworthy enough for production use.
* **Codebase Contribution:** 
 Write code that your teammates can read, review, and build on without friction.
  

  



**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** 




**Required** 




 – 1\-3 years of Python development with at least one production deployment behind you.
 



 – Solid grasp of async Python and REST API design, with the debugging instincts to match.
 



 – Hands\-on experience with LangChain or a comparable LLM orchestration library.
 



 – Working knowledge of Azure: OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and App Service or Container Apps.
 



 – You understand why output validation, structured schemas, and retry logic matter in production — not just that they exist.
 



 – Comfortable working in a shared codebase with other engineers.
 



**Preferred** 




 – Pydantic for structured output parsing and schema validation.
 



 – Experience with RAG pipelines or document ingestion workflows.
 



 – Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
 



 – Any prior work building multi\-step or tool\-using LLM agents.
 



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 We are not looking for someone who knows everything. We are looking for someone who ships, learns, and communicates clearly. A strong candidate will be able to show:
 



 – You have built a REST API that other services depend on.
 



 – You have integrated an external API and handled its failure modes, not just the happy path.
 



 – You can explain a design decision, defend it under pushback, and revise it when shown a better argument.
 



**OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS ROLE** 




 In the interest of honesty, the following are not part of this position:
 



 – Prompt engineering as the primary responsibility.
 



 – Frontend or UI development.
 



 – Machine learning model training or fine\-tuning.
 



 – Autonomous deployment to production environments without engineer review.
 



**TECHNOLOGY STACK** 




 Python  \|  FastAPI  \|  LangChain  \|  Azure OpenAI  \|  Azure Blob Storage  \|  Container Apps  \|  Pydantic  \|  GitHub / Azure DevOps
 



**WHY WORK WITH US** 




 – You will work on systems that are used in real projects by real teams — not internal demos or sandboxed experiments.
 



 – You will work closely with senior engineers and architects, not be left to figure things out alone.
 



 – Code quality, system design, and governance are taken seriously here. Your standards will be matched.
 



 – Remote\-friendly and outcome\-focused. We care about what you ship, not when you log in.
