title: Account Manager
description:
Role Overview

Akhil Dev Productions LLP is looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented **Accounts Manager** to manage the company’s accounting, taxation, financial records, statutory compliance, payments, reporting, and day\-to\-day finance operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **GST, Income Tax Returns, TDS, Zoho Books, Microsoft Excel, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and financial reporting**. The role requires accuracy, confidentiality, proper documentation, and timely coordination with management, auditors, consultants, vendors, clients, and government authorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the company’s complete day\-to\-day accounting activities.
* Maintain accurate books of accounts using Zoho Books or other approved accounting software.
* Record sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments, journal entries, and bank transactions.
* Prepare and issue invoices, debit notes, credit notes, payment receipts, and account statements.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Follow up with clients regarding pending payments and outstanding invoices.
* Verify vendor invoices, supporting documents, approvals, and payment schedules.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly bank reconciliations.
* Maintain petty cash, expense statements, advances, reimbursements, and project\-wise expenses.
* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, balance sheets, cash\-flow reports, and management reports.
* Track budgets, actual expenses, outstanding liabilities, receivables, and project profitability.
* Maintain separate accounting records for film productions, media projects, marketing campaigns, and company operations.

GST and Statutory Compliance

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, annual returns, and other applicable filings.
* Reconcile GST input tax credit with purchase records and GSTR\-2B.
* Ensure proper GST classification, tax rates, HSN or SAC codes, and invoice compliance.
* Monitor GST notices, mismatches, outstanding liabilities, and filing deadlines.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants and tax consultants for GST assessments and audits.
* Maintain proper records for statutory inspections, audits, and compliance reviews.

Income Tax and TDS

* Assist with preparation and filing of company and individual Income Tax Returns.
* Calculate, deduct, deposit, and reconcile TDS within applicable deadlines.
* Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns.
* Issue and maintain Form 16, Form 16A, and other applicable tax certificates.
* Support advance\-tax calculations and tax\-planning activities.
* Reconcile Form 26AS, Annual Information Statement, and Taxpayer Information Summary records.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants for tax audits, assessments, notices, and statutory filings.

Zoho Books Responsibilities

* Configure and maintain the chart of accounts, taxes, customers, vendors, items, and banking records in Zoho Books.
* Manage invoices, recurring invoices, expenses, bills, payments, credit notes, and bank feeds.
* Reconcile Zoho Books records with bank statements, GST returns, and supporting documents.
* Generate financial reports, ageing reports, tax summaries, cash\-flow statements, and project reports.
* Maintain proper document attachments and supporting records within the accounting system.
* Ensure all accounting entries are updated accurately and on time.

Excel and Reporting Responsibilities

* Prepare financial reports, expense trackers, payment schedules, budgets, and reconciliations using Microsoft Excel.
* Use formulas, pivot tables, lookup functions, filters, conditional formatting, and data validation.
* Create project\-wise, department\-wise, and monthly financial summaries.
* Maintain dashboards for receivables, payables, GST, TDS, cash flow, and upcoming payment commitments.
* Analyse financial data and report discrepancies, unusual expenses, and cost overruns to management.
* Prepare customised reports requested by the management team.

Payroll and Employee Accounts

* Prepare monthly payroll, salary statements, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, and final settlements.
* Maintain attendance\-linked salary information in coordination with HR and management.
* Support PF, ESI, professional tax, and other applicable payroll compliances.
* Maintain employee advance, loan, reimbursement, and expense records.
* Prepare salary\-related reports and payment instructions.

Audit and Documentation

* Maintain organised digital and physical records of invoices, bills, agreements, receipts, vouchers, and tax documents.
* Prepare schedules and supporting documents for internal and statutory audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, Chartered Accountants, banks, consultants, and government departments.
* Respond to audit queries and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Maintain confidentiality of all company, employee, client, vendor, and financial information.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of practical experience in accounting and finance.
* Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax Returns, accounting standards, and statutory compliance.
* Practical experience using Zoho Books.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in invoicing, bank reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.
* Ability to coordinate independently with Chartered Accountants, auditors, banks, clients, and vendors.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, organisation, and deadline management.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Malayalam.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in film production, media, advertising, digital marketing, events, or project\-based businesses.
* Knowledge of production accounting, project budgeting, artist payments, technician payments, and vendor settlements.
* Familiarity with LLP and private limited company compliance.
* Experience handling multiple companies, projects, bank accounts, and GST registrations.
* Knowledge of Zoho Expense, Zoho Payroll, Tally, or other accounting platforms will be an advantage.
* CA Inter, CMA Inter, M.Com, MBA Finance, or relevant professional certification will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be trustworthy, responsible, organised, and capable of independently managing the accounts and finance department. The candidate must be comfortable handling confidential financial information and should proactively identify compliance deadlines, payment obligations, accounting discrepancies, and financial risks.

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries.
* Timely GST, TDS, Income Tax, and statutory filings.
* Accuracy of bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Timely collection of client receivables.
* Proper management of vendor payments and outstanding liabilities.
* Quality and accuracy of monthly financial reports.
* Proper maintenance of invoices, vouchers, and supporting documents.
* Effective control of project expenses, budgets, and cash flow.
* Zero avoidable penalties caused by delayed or incorrect statutory filings.

Pay: ₹15,465\.03 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Country HR Manager India
description:
Lead Country HR for India as the local HR partner and employee\-facing HR leader, ensuring that global HR strategies are translated into compliant, relevant and effective country actions. The role partners with business leaders, managers, HRBPs, COEs and HR Operations Services to strengthen employee engagement, local talent and performance management, employee relations, culture, compliance and organizational effectiveness across India. Act as the connector between local business needs and Sidel’s HR model, ensuring that HR programs, policies and processes are implemented with the right balance of global consistency and local adaptation. Provide advice and coaching to managers and employees, while ensuring smooth collaboration with HR Operations Services on transactional processes such as talent acquisition, onboarding, payroll, data and employee lifecycle administration. Own local employee relations and industrial relations matters where applicable, including grievance, disciplinary, legal and compliance cases, ensuring timely, fair and compliant resolution in line with Sidel policies and Indian labour regulations. In line with Group policies, the HR operating model and local labour law, the Country HR Manager is responsible for country\-specific HR delivery and advisory activities for India, while coordinating closely with regional HR, HRBPs, COEs and HR Operations Services to ensure seamless employee and manager experience.



### **Your Mission**


* YOUR MISSION


Country HR leadership: Act as the primary HR point of contact for India, representing HR locally and ensuring managers and employees receive clear, consistent and timely HR support.  

Business partnering: Advise and coach managers on people topics, workforce planning, organization effectiveness, performance, engagement, retention and change management.  

Employee relations and compliance: Manage employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, sensitive cases and statutory requirements in line with local labour law and Sidel governance.  

Local policies and governance: Maintain country policies, procedures and employee communications, ensuring they remain current, compliant and aligned with Group guidance.  

Talent and performance: Drive local implementation of talent, performance, succession, development and engagement processes; coach managers to ensure quality conversations and follow\-through on actions.  

Talent acquisition collaboration: Partner with hiring managers, TA Operations, HRBPs and COEs through requisition, selection, offer and onboarding stages, with Country HR leading local package alignment, candidate experience and stakeholder management where required.  

Employee engagement and culture: Anchor local culture, employee listening, engagement actions and employer value proposition initiatives; strengthen Sidel’s local employer brand in India.  

HR Operations interface: Work with HR Operations Services to ensure efficient delivery of payroll, onboarding, exits, mobility, HR data, documentation and other employee lifecycle processes.  

Data and insights: Use HR data, dashboards and workforce insights to support decision\-making, identify people risks, track process quality and advise managers with facts and trends.  

Manager capability: Support people managers through guidance, training and practical tools on core people processes, performance management, engagement, employee relations and change leadership.  

Health, safety and wellbeing: Promote a safe, respectful and inclusive work environment, partnering with local leaders and HSE as needed.  

Industrial relations: Manage union or works council interactions where applicable and maintain a constructive labour relations environment.  

Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, harmonize and improve HR processes, contributing to digital adoption, data quality, automation and consistent employee experience.
### **Your Profile**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or related discipline is preferred.  

HR certification or formal training in labour law, employee relations, HR business partnering, coaching or change management is a plus.  

Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in international, manufacturing, capital equipment, engineering, industrial or service environments.  

Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, statutory requirements, employee relations practices and local HR governance.  

Proven HR business partnering experience, with ability to coach managers, influence stakeholders and translate business needs into practical people actions.  

Experience managing employee relations, performance, talent, engagement, organizational change and local policy implementation.  

Ability to collaborate effectively with HR Operations Services, HRBPs, COEs and regional HR teams in a matrix organization.  

Data\-driven mindset with comfort using HR systems, dashboards and insights to support decisions and improve process quality.  

Strong communication, consulting, problem\-solving and stakeholder management skills; able to balance empathy, compliance and business impact.  

Multicultural mindset and ability to work effectively with local, regional and global teams.  

Fluent in English; local language capability relevant to India is an advantage.

title: System Admin
description:
**Job Description**

**System Administrator**




**Department**




IT / Infrastructure




**Reports To**




IT Manager / Head of IT




**Experience**




4–5 years




**Employment Type**




Full\-time




**Location**




Ahmedabad




**Grade / Level**




Mid\-Level (IC)




**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented System Administrator with 4–5 years of experience to manage, maintain, and secure our organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for day\-to\-day system administration, network and server management, and driving efficiency across our core platforms — Microsoft 365 (users, licensing, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, security \& compliance), Datto (RMM, endpoint monitoring, patching, and backup/BCDR), the Zoho application suite (Zoho People, Mail, Desk/CRM, Creator), and Time Doctor (workforce time \& productivity tracking). You will play a key role in ensuring high system uptime, data security, and smooth technology operations across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Infrastructure Management:** Install, configure, and maintain servers, workstations, printers, and network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, access points).
* **M365 Administration:** Administer the Microsoft 365 tenant end\-to\-end — user/license provisioning, Exchange Online mail flow and mailboxes, Teams and SharePoint/OneDrive administration, conditional access, MFA, and security \& compliance center policies.
* **Datto (RMM \& Backup/BCDR):** Manage endpoint monitoring, patch management, remote support, and automated alerts through Datto RMM; configure and monitor Datto backup/BCDR (image\-based and Datto SaaS Protection for M365\) and regularly verify backup integrity and restore readiness.
* **Zoho Administration:** Administer and support the organization's Zoho ecosystem (Zoho People, Zoho Mail, Zoho CRM/Desk, Zoho Creator/Analytics) — user provisioning, roles, workflows, and integrations.
* **Time Doctor Administration:** Configure and maintain Time Doctor for accurate time tracking and productivity reporting; manage user/team setup, projects, and generate attendance/productivity reports for management.
* **User \& Access Management:** Manage user accounts, access rights, and permissions across M365, Zoho, Datto, Time Doctor, and other systems in line with security policy (joiner–mover–leaver process).
* **Network Administration:** Monitor network performance and security, manage firewalls, VPNs, and ensure safe, uninterrupted connectivity.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement and monitor antivirus/endpoint protection (via Datto RMM), patch management, firewall rules, and M365 security policies; respond to and document security incidents.
* **Backup \& Disaster Recovery:** Own the backup and disaster recovery strategy using Datto BCDR and Datto SaaS Protection; maintain regular backups of servers, databases, M365 data, and critical business data; test recovery procedures periodically.
* **IT Support \& Troubleshooting:** Provide L1/L2 technical support to end users for hardware, software, network, M365, Zoho, and Time Doctor issues; maintain a ticketing log and track resolution against SLAs.
* **Asset \& Vendor Management:** Maintain accurate records of IT assets, M365/Zoho/Datto/Time Doctor licenses, warranties, and AMC/vendor contracts; coordinate with vendors for procurement, renewals, and repairs.
* **Documentation \& Policy:** Maintain SOPs, network diagrams, and system documentation for M365, Datto, Zoho, and Time Doctor configurations; ensure IT processes align with organizational policies.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve system reliability, especially through Zoho Creator/Flow, Datto RMM automation policies, and scripting (PowerShell).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4–5 years of hands\-on experience as a System Administrator or in a similar IT infrastructure role.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server/Linux administration, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VPN, firewalls).
* **M365:** Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Azure AD/Entra ID, security \& compliance policies) is required.
* **Datto:** Experience with Datto RMM and Datto backup/BCDR (or comparable RMM and backup solutions) is strongly preferred.
* **Zoho:** Practical experience administering Zoho applications (Zoho People, Mail, CRM/Desk, Creator) is highly preferred.
* **Time Doctor:** Exposure to Time Doctor or similar time\-tracking/productivity monitoring tools is a plus.
* Familiarity with backup solutions, antivirus/endpoint security tools, and patch management.
* Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell, Bash, or similar) is a plus for automation tasks.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to support non\-technical staff patiently and effectively.
* Relevant certifications (Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, CompTIA Network\+/Server\+, MCSA, CCNA, ITIL Foundation, or Zoho certifications) are an added advantage.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
=====================================

**Key Result Areas (KRAs) \& Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
================================================================




**Key Result Area (KRA)**




**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**




System \& Network Uptime




Maintain 99\.5% uptime for servers, network, M365, and critical business systems each month.




M365 Administration




100% of user/license provisioning\-deprovisioning completed within 24 hrs; zero unauthorized access incidents; MFA/conditional access compliance at 100%.




Datto RMM \& Endpoint Management




98% of endpoints patched and reporting healthy in Datto RMM each month; critical patches applied within 72 hrs of release.




Datto Backup / BCDR




100% successful scheduled backup jobs (servers \+ M365 via SaaS Protection); backup/restore test performed at least quarterly with \< 4 hr Recovery Time Objective (RTO).




Zoho Platform Administration




100% timely (within 24 hrs) user provisioning/deprovisioning in Zoho apps; 2 workflow/config errors per quarter.




Time Doctor Administration




100% of active employees correctly set up and tracked in Time Doctor; attendance/productivity reports delivered to management on schedule (e.g., weekly/monthly) with zero data gaps.




IT Support \& Ticket Resolution




Average ticket resolution time within SLA (e.g., L1 4 hrs, L2 24 hrs); 90% employee satisfaction on support tickets.




Security \& Compliance




Zero critical security incidents caused by unpatched systems or misconfigured access; 100% of devices with updated antivirus/patches monthly.




Asset \& Vendor Management




IT asset register (incl. M365/Zoho/Datto/Time Doctor licenses) updated within 48 hrs of any change; renewals/AMCs tracked with zero lapses.




Process Improvement \& Automation




At least 2–3 process automations (e.g., via Zoho Flow/Creator, Datto RMM policies, or PowerShell scripts) implemented per quarter to reduce manual effort.




Documentation




100% of systems/processes (M365, Datto, Zoho, Time Doctor) have updated SOPs and configuration documentation, reviewed at least quarterly.




**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary as per industry standards and experience.
* Opportunity to work with a modern, Zoho\-driven digital workplace.
* Collaborative work environment with scope for skill development and certifications.

*Note: This job description is a general outline of responsibilities and may be updated to reflect evolving organizational needs.*

description:
This role plays a crucial role in planning and executing the organization’s L\&D plans by upskilling all employees and ensuring that the workforce is aligned with necessary skills. Additionally, the role is responsible for conducting all training programmes \& processes, in\-line with a well\-defined and governed SOP. The role is also expected to plan and conduct programmes for emerging and existing leaders to harness leadership development in the orgainsation.
 



  





**Leadership Development** 



* Assess the requirements to grow leadership within the organisation and examine the linkage of the requirements with business goals.
* Assess the current capabilities of those in key roles to understand skill gaps
* Create and get relevant programmes delivered to meet the requirements



  





**Management of Strategic Corporate Training Programmes** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive learning and development strategies that align with the company’s vision, mission, and goals.
* Drive corporate training programmes, that are important for the organisation such as Diversity, Compliances, Values etc
* Ensure that L\&D initiatives support key organizational transformations such as digitalization, culture change, leadership development, and innovation.



  





**Program Development \& Delivery:** 



* Design, execute, and manage a variety of learning programs, including onboarding, technical skills training and soft skills.
* Leverage modern learning tools and platforms such as Learning Management Systems (LMS), virtual classrooms, and blended learning solutions.
* Oversee the adaptation and localization of training programs to fit regional and cultural differences in a global workforce.



  





**Budget \& Resource Management:** 



* Oversee the L\&D budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources for training initiatives.
* Build relationships with external vendors, consultants, and educational institutions to bring in specialized expertise and certifications.



  





**Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting:** 



* Track the effectiveness and ROI of L\&D programs through assessments, feedback surveys, performance metrics, and business outcomes.
* Provide regular reports and updates to senior leadership on program outcomes, employee development progress, and any improvements needed.



  





**SOP Creation and Maintenance:** 



* Develop, document, and regularly update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all training programs, ensuring they align with organizational standards, compliance, and industry best practices.
* Conduct periodic audits of training SOPs and processes to ensure compliance and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Identify areas of improvement within existing training processes and work to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and enhance learner experience.

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Professional Education/Diploma in Human Resources or Learning or OD



  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in Human Resources with extensive experience in organisational development and culture change.

description:

--------------------

**Job Purpose**

Reporting to the COO of ASIA HUM, the incumbent will station in our offshore HR Hub (HRSSC) and be the business contact for HR Cruise team (both HRCO and CFT) in collecting business requirement, analyzing any local needs of all ASIA BU entities and providinge to the Business Analyst and Product Owner for further calibration and implementation. Business representation


1\. Represent ASIA HUM team, including Functional Process Owners, on any HR Cruise Activities and in case of issues, or conflicting views, collect and evaluate the business needs and provide final recommendation to ASIA HUM EXCO


2\. Run ASIA HUM HR Cruise SteerCo, provide regular update to SteerCo on the HR Cruise roadmap, including any enhancements, quarterly releases, and major incidents, as well as its impacts on HR service delivery, recommend to SteerCo on any change management actions including communication, resource management, stakeholder managements, or any other actions to ensure continuous service delivery.


3\. Participate in the PMT Board WFA and **Monthly RR** meetings and represent ASIA HUM to provide views, escalate concerns, and provide further guidance or input to ASIA HUM teams on any actions required.

6\. Work with all Functional Process Owners and ASIA HUM team on any complicated issues and align common objectives. Provide support and guidance as appropriate.


7\. Work with Product Owners, FPO (of ASIA HUM), and CFT **SPOC** to provide feedback on the target operating model, clarify roles and responsibilities to ensure effective and efficient service delivery


Global HR Cruise Run activities


6\. Be consulted by HR Cruise team on any run activities on global topics, including but not limited functional tests, wave deployment, and quarterly releases.


Local HR Cruise Run activities (including but not limited to local interfaces)


8\. Provide to CFT SPOC the business requirements on local topics (including the local interfaces) and review the business requirement prepared by CFT team to ensure the business requirements are covered.


7\. Provide input to the CFT SPOC in reviewing design documents and assessing whether enhancements are needed—especially for complex interface extraction rules (TRICOR, WTW, AUS ADP, SMM, MIR3\)

Trouble Shooting


9\. initiate requests to CFT SPOC BA for performing full data analysis to identify impacted name list so as to understand the impact and root causes of the issues


10\. Be informed and consulted timely by CFT on any incidents and its impacts to service delivery. Update ASIA HUM and any stakeholders in ASIA


**1\.** Validate JIRA ticket issued by CFT and monitor progress of technical investigation (Note: for global topics the ticket will be done by PO and validated globally )


12\. 12\. Work with L1 support and data management team to provide information required by CFT SPOC BA team to analyze issues..

* Responsibility – the incumbent should have strong ability to manage projects, multi\-complicated activities across different teams

HR Organization: Strategy, and Development

description:
Job Description – Financial Analyst (Finance \& Operations)

Role Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our finance team. The candidate should possess a minimum of one year of relevant experience and demonstrate strong attention to detail. In this capacity, the candidate will support budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and reporting activities, thereby contributing to critical business decisions. This role offers significant opportunities for professional development and exposure to a broad spectrum of financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

i. Financial Reporting and Analysis

· Creating regular financial reports that include income statements, profit and loss accounts, balance sheets, cash flow statements etc for the client as well as management.

· Adherence to the tasks scheduled in the Cadence Report.

· Timely delivery of deliverables within cost to the client's satisfaction.

· Preparing and maintaining accurate accounting records, ensuring all financial transactions are properly documented and recorded.

ii. Cost Analysis \& Expense Management

· Identify opportunities to reduce costs within ongoing or future projects.

· Assist in forecasting project expenditures to support financial planning.

· Analyze variances between planned and actual costs and report findings.

· Prepare cost reports and dashboards for management review.

· Implement cost control measures and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

iii. Market \& Industry Research

· Monitoring real estate market trends, including rental rates, property prices, occupancy rates, and economic factors affecting the industry.

· Analyzing competitors’ rental pricing strategies, market positioning, and performance to recommend pricing adjustments or strategic decisions.

· Analyse customer preferences and demand patterns to support strategic planning.

· Track regulatory and policy changes impacting property management, leasing, and development.

iv. Report to Stakeholders

· Communicating with investors and stakeholders by providing detailed reports on financial performance, key metrics, and updates on property projects.

· Presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision\-making.

v. Data Management and Automation

· Using financial modeling tools, spreadsheets, or software (e.g., Excel, ERP systems) to analyze financial data and track performance.

· Streamlining reporting processes through the use of automation tools to reduce manual work and increase accuracy.

· Maintain accurate financial and operational records in accordance with company and project policies.

· Assist with document preparation and filing, ensuring everything is organized and easily accessible

vi. Compliance and Risk Management

· Ensure compliance with financial regulations, company policies, client requirements and industry standards.

· Help identify and assess financial and operational risks to be faced by the company or project, suggesting mitigation strategies.

vii. Collaboration and Communication

· Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, ensuring smooth communication between finance, operations, and other departments.

· Provide administrative support for finance\-related tasks as needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications

· Graduate or postgraduate in Commerce, CMA, or ACCA qualified.

· 1\+ years of experience in accounting, or a related role.

· Experience in Financial Data Analytics is an added advantage.

· Experience in real estate accounting is preferred but not essential.

· Should be flexible to work night shifts, as required.

· Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making abilities.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word techniques.

· Familiarity with financial software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, Tally etc.) is a plus.

· Basic understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and reporting.

· Attention to detail and the ability to work with large sets of data.

· Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.

The candidate should be based in Trivandrum and should not be an absolute fresher. Candidates with a minimum of 6 months of relevant work experience (excluding internships) are preferred.

***Candidates willing to work for night shift are preferred.***
